{{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Akshan''' uses a {{tip|basic attack}}, he fires an additional shot after a delay that deals {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minions}}. Issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} on a different target before the additional shot has been launched causes '''Akshan''' to fire it at the new target. If the second shot is cancelled instead, he gains {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 75}}|ms}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 1 second.
The additional shot applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Akshan's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dirty Fighting'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal them {{as|{{pp|15;40;80;150|1;6;11;16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' will also gain a {{pplevel|40+(240/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds. The shield may be gained only once every few seconds.
Physical Magic
* If the first shot has killed its target, '''Akshan''' will automatically acquire another enemy within 200 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}}, else he can do so by issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} to a different target.
* Applies {{tip|basic damage}} for the second shot and {{tip|proc damage}} for the bonus damage.
* The second shot:
** Is treated as a basic attack.
** {{sti|critical strike|Critically strikes}} independently from the first shot.
** Can be cancelled by inputting a different command right after using the first shot.
** Counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
** Starts the attack windup's cooldown after it is used, rather than when the first shot is.
* The attack speed scaling on the movement speed buff includes the bonus attack speed gained from '''Akshan's''' innate attack speed growth.
** At level 20, at minimum it grants {{fd|{{#expr: (20+(75-20)/17*(20-1)) * (1 + ({{ccd|Akshan|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1)))*0.01) round 2}}}} decaying movement speed.
* Changing targets for the second shot will also {{tip|acquisition range|acquire}} the new target.
* The second shot, if the first shot's target was killed, will prioritize {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions, then {{tip|minion|minions}} on {{sti|health|{{as|low health}}}}.
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Akshan''' marks enemy {{tip|champions}} that kill allied champions as ''Scoundrels'' for 60 seconds. If '''Akshan''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''Scoundrel'' while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, he receives an additional {{g|100}} and resurrects all {{tip|death|dead}} allied champions that they have slain after 1 second.
When '''Akshan''' claims a ''Scoundrel's'' bounty he removes the marks of all other enemies. ''Scoundrels'' refresh their mark duration on subsequent kills, and will have their mark removed when they die by any means. '''Akshan''' cannot mark enemies as ''Scoundrels'' while they are dead. Allies are resurrected at their [[Spawn|summoning platform]].
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' enters {{tip|camouflage}}, which lasts indefinitely while he is near [[terrain]] or inside {{tip|brush}}, and for 2 seconds otherwise. During this time, he can see trails leading toward ''Scoundrels'', and while facing them if they are within {{tt|5000|Pending for test}} units, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' mana regeneration}}}} equal to {{as|12% of his '''missing''' mana}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
''Going Rogue'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after its duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Going Rogue'' immediately.
'''''Akshan''' can move during Going Rogue's cast time.''
{{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' ends ''Going Rogue''.
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|80 to 120}}}}
{{ap|18 to 2}}
{{ap|40 to 0}}
Mana
* The mark displays the duration and slay count.
** Enemy champions that kill '''Akshan''' will not be marked as ''Scoundrels'' nor increase their slay count.
* {{tip|Clone|Clones}} do not count for triggering ''Going Rogue's'' passive.
* ''Going Rogue's'' buff refreshes to last indefinitely upon moving near terrain or into brush, and will refresh to 2 seconds after leaving near terrain or brush.
* Allied champions within a {{tip|zombie state}} are resurrected only after the state ends.
* '''Akshan''' can still trigger ''Going Rogue's'' passive while he is within a {{tip|zombie state}}.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.

''Heroic Swing's'' second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or '''Akshan''' is {{tt|moved|See notes}} or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} within the duration, the preparation will end prematurely, cancelling ''Heroic Swing'' in the process. {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Akshan''' {{tip|dash|swings}} around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to his {{tt|facing direction|See notes}}, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, he fires at the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy every {{rutngt|0.2}} to deal them {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness.

''Comeuppance'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Comeuppance'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if the channel is cancelled.
{{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' fires all stored bullets at the target, each briefly granting {{tip|sight}} around their trajectory and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}, as well as by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. The shots can hit {{tip|structures}}.
Each bullet's damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}}.

* ''Comeuppance'' refreshes the duration of ''{{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}'' stacks on the target every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
* A kill threshold will appear on the [[health bar]] of the target locked onto during the channel, which increases each time '''Akshan''' stores a bullet. If the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} falls below the threshold, their health bar will be framed in red.
** The indicator factors the bonus damage applied by {{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}} as well as [[damage modifier|damage modifiers]] and the target's resistances.
** It also factors the projected increase in the target's {{as|'''missing''' health}}, from which each consecutive bullet scales more.
** It updates dynamically over the channel's duration, reacting to fluctuations of the target's health and damage mitigations.
* The {{tip|true sight|reveal}} will linger for 2 seconds after the channel has ended.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the lock-on and will only block a single bullet.
* ''Comeuppance'' will not go on a reduced cooldown if '''Akshan''' {{tip|death|dies}} during the channel.
* ''Comeuppance'' will cancel if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} or {{tip|death|dies}} during the channel.
* Damage to structures '''does''' scale with their {{as|'''missing''' health}}.
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
* ''Comeuppance'' is special cased to put {{cai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko}} on cooldown when targeting '''Neeko''' and to break the disguise before damaging her.

{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aphelios''' has access to an arsenal of 5 ''Moonstone Weapons'', created by his sister '''Alune'''. He equips two weapons at any one time, one as his {{as|main weapon}} and one as his {{as|off-hand}}. Each weapon has a unique {{tip|basic attack}} and effect.
'''Aphelios''' begins the game with {{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}} as his {{as|main weapon}} and {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} in his {{as|off-hand}}, with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}, {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} queued in reserve. His weapons are initially in this order, but they can be rearranged based on their usage.
{{sbc|Innate - Moonlight:}} Weapons granted to '''Aphelios''' have 50 ''Moonlight'' for [[ammunition]], which is consumed upon basic attacking {{tip|on-attack}} and upon casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}}. Any of his abilities that automatically cause him to attack during their effect will not consume additional ''Moonlight''. Once his {{as|main weapon's}} ''Moonlight'' is exhausted, it is moved to the end of the reserve queue; '''Alune''' then assembles his next available weapon from the reserve over 1 second, placing its {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary ability}} on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{sti|cooldown}} from the start of the assembly. '''Aphelios''' cannot cast ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' during the assembly.
{{sbc|Innate - Weapon Master:}} '''Aphelios''' cannot improve his abilities via [[Experience (champion)|skill points]]. He starts the game with ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' and automatically gains access to his [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] primary abilities at level 2 and his [[File:R.png|20px|link=]] ultimate ability, ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'', at level 6. ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'' improves automatically at levels 11 and 16. '''Aphelios''' may spend his skill points to gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} or {{sti|{{as|lethality}}}} instead.
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 24 6}}|ad}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{as|{{ap|9 to 54 6}}%|as}}}}
{{st|Lethality|{{as|{{ap|4.5 to 27 6}}|lethality}}}}
* The [[attack damage]], [[attack speed]] and [[lethality]] within '''Aphelios' '''unique rank-up menu in the HUD correspond to the Q, W, E ability rank-up [[hotkey]]s, respectively, for the purposes of assigning skill points via keyboard.
* Due to '''Aphelios''' lacking a fourth rankup option (R), his point assigment does not follow the same rules as other champions.
** For example, the earliest level that an individual statistic can attain rank 6 is level 9, by assigning points at levels {{ap|1|2|3|5|7|9}}.
* An ammunition counter will appear to the right side of the screen when '''Aphelios' '''{{as|main weapon}} has 10 or less ''Moonlight''.
* While at lower than 10 ''Moonlight'', casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}} will not spend additional ''Moonlight'' but instead consume all the remaining points.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} will not consume additional ''Moonlight'' when firing its bolts.
* The in-game tooltip will reflect the current order of weapons.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' casts forth a lunar spotlight in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path and stops upon illuminating an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}. '''Alune''' smites the area centered on the illuminated target, dealing {{as|{{pp|125 to 225 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemy champions struck and locking-on to each target hit, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds.
After {{fd|0.3}} seconds of the illumination, attacks based on '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|main weapon}} will launch from the sky against each locked-on target, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. These attacks can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{critical damage|100 to 130|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} damage. There is no {{sti|range}} limit for locked-on targets.
{{lc|{{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}}}} Applies an empowered mark that deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 110 for 3|6 to 16}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}}} per ''mark'' consumed.
{{lc|{{ai|Severum|Aphelios}}}} {{tip|Heals}} '''Aphelios''' for {{pp|250 to 450 for 3|6 to 16|color=heal}} if at least one enemy champion is hit.
{{lc|{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}}} Increases the initial {{tip|slow}} to 99% and empowers ''{{ai|Binding Eclipse|Aphelios}}'' to {{tip|root}} targets affected by the enhanced slow for {{fd|1.35}} seconds.
{{lc|{{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}}} The initial blast deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 150 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.{{ft|The attack instead deals {{as|110% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} against locked-on targets, and causes an explosion of bolts in a 400-radius circle that deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|110*0.75*0.9 to 110*0.9 for 2|1 to 9}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to targets hit.|Performs ''Infernum's'' attacks and ''Infernum's'' bolts in a 400-radius circle: primary targets are dealt ''Infernum's'' primary damage; secondary targets are dealt 90% of ''Infernum's'' regular bolt damage; both are modified by ''Moonlight Vigil's'' {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} modifier.}}Enemy champions will take damage from overlapping areas.
{{lc|{{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}}}} Generates 5 additional spectral ''Chakrams'' that return to '''Aphelios''' from the first enemy champion hit, for a total of 6, on top of those from other targets hit.
{{pp|120 to 100 for 3|6 to 16}}
100
Mana
physical
* When critically striking, the attacks on locked-on targets when using {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} deal slightly more than 120% damage.{{bug}} '''It is currently unknown where this damage originates from.'''
** For example, at level 6 with no {{sti|attack damage}} bonuses, '''Aphelios''' will deal {{as|{{ap|({{ccd|Aphelios|dam_base}}+{{ccd|Aphelios|dam_lvl}}*(6-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(6-1)))*(1.75-0.55)*1.05}}}} damage (approximated) from those attacks, whereas they are normally expected to deal {{as|{{ap|({{ccd|Aphelios|dam_base}}+{{ccd|Aphelios|dam_lvl}}*(6-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(6-1)))*(1.75-0.55)}}}}. This discrepancy increases with higher {{as|attack damage}}.
** {{Pending for test}} It is also unknown whether this is just a [[Practice Tool]] bug.
** {{sbc|Note:}} Values are outdated due to patch [[V26.01]].
* Attacks do not apply [[on-attack effects]].
* The attacks always count as {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} unless {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} is being used. The lunar spotlight, however, may always be intercepted regardless of which weapon is in play as the {{as|main weapon}}.
** Due to this fact, non-{{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} attacks will hit targets that are farther away from the center of the blast at a slightly longer delay.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block ''Moonlight Vigil's'' initial detonation damage but does not prevent the attacks from locking-on.
* All attacks from ''Moonlight Vigil'' {{tip|critically strike}} independently from each other.
** This includes {{ais|Infernum|Aphelios}} bolts, which also critically strike independently from the primary attack's damage.
* Changing weapons while ''Moonlight Vigil'' is in flight does not change the effect it has when it hits.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* ''Moonlight Vigil's'' effect radius is centered around the location of the missile as it collides.
* With {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}}, the extra flat heal is given only once, not per target. However, all damage done by ''Moonlight Vigil'' with it also heals him from ''Severum's '' own passive effect.
* With {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, 14 fire bolts splash from each target hit (18 for {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}}). Bolts do not activate if ''Moonlight Vigil's'' initial damage [[kill]]s the target.
* With {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}}, 1 spectral chakram is generated for every target hit, meaning it is possible to generate up to 10 spectral chakrams with one cast of ''Moonlight Vigil'' if it hits 5 enemy champions.
* The locked-on attacks' can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, but won't be prevented if '''Aphelios''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** Preventing the attack also prevents the additional effect (e.g. marking them with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}} or granting {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios|spectral chakrams}}).
* ''Moonlight Vigil'' has different visual effects changed accordingly to each weapon. ''This may vary depending on the [[skin]], this showcases the '''default''':''

{{sbc|Passive:}} While ''Ranger's Focus'' is inactive, '''Ashe's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Focus'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
{{sbc|Active:}} For 6 seconds, '''Ashe''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}. The flurries {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}'' per arrow, but apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once.
''Ranger's Focus {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ashe's''' basic attack timer.''
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
{{st|Physical Damage Per Arrow|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:ad1}}/5 to {{#var:ad5}}/5}}% AD}}|Total Damage Per Flurry|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:ad1}} to {{#var:ad5}}}}% AD}}}}
30
Mana + 4 Focus
Physical
* The flurries deal 1 instance of {{tip|basic damage}} followed by 4 instances of a non-reactive type of damage (either {{tip|default damage|default}} or {{tip|proc damage|proc}}).<!--One test to determine the difference is Teemo's W, but the test is hard to set-up since the first bolt removes Teemo's W.-->
** The flurries are classified as a basic attack on a {{tip|script}} level, but are considered an ability for other effects (e.g. {{cai|Sap Magic|Maokai}}).{{Bug}}
* The first flurry of a ''Ranger's Focus'' cast fires{{ft|one additional arrow, dealing 20% increased total damage.|six arrows, dealing a total of {{as|{{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*1.2 to {{#var:ad5}}*1.2}}%|attack damage}} {{as|attack damage}}.}}
* ''Ranger's Focus'' works against {{tip|structures}}.
* Flat damage reductions (e.g. {{cai|Tantrum|Amumu}}, {{cai|Nimble Fighter|Fizz}}, or {{cai|Eclipse|Leona}}) apply per arrow, resulting in extremely increased effectiveness against ''Ranger's Focus''.
** The sole exception is {{iis|Warden's Mail}} {{nie|Rock Solid}}, as that applies per {{tip|cast instance}} rather than per damage instance.
* A flurry can apply 5 stacks of {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}} to a single target as it deals 5 instances of {{as|physical damage}}.
* ''Ranger's Focus'' also empowers {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} bolts to become a flurry of 5 bolts each as well.
** The empowered bolts use '''Ashe's''' attack projectile, including her missile speed (2500 compared to their default 2000).
** The bolts are evenly distributed among the targets, but a single target cannot be hit by more than 5 bolts.
** These flurries also apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once to each target hit.
* Because ''Focus'' stacks are generated {{tip|on-attack}}, {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nies|Wind's Fury}} bolts will not generate any.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' calls forth a phalanx of soldiers from {{tt|175|See notes}} units behind him, catching enemies from up to {{tt|325|See notes}} units behind him and charging forward {{tt|575|See notes}} units in the target direction.
Enemies impacted by the charge are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked away}} over 1 second to a line 650 units in front of '''Azir'''.
Upon finishing their charge, the soldiers stand as a wall for 5 seconds, acting as impassible terrain against enemies and granting {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings. '''Azir''' and his allies can move through these soldiers.
{{st|Width|{{ap|6 to 8}} soldiers|Width (charge)|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{ap|620 to 820}}|Width (impassable wall)|{{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{ap|750 to 950}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 600}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
{{ap|120|105|90}}
100
mana
Magic
* {{tip|Monster|Monsters}} are also {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}.
* The soldier units are spawned only 175 units behind '''Azir''', but do not control the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} directly. Each comes with a missile that travels the same path and conveys the damage and knockback effect.
** The furthest area (from 325 to 175 units behind '''Azir''') is covered by a separate set of missiles with the same effects.
** All of the soldiers and their missiles will end the charge prematurely when one encounters {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} / {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} / {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} / {{ai|Rebuttal|Mel}} or upon colliding with terrain that they cannot charge through.
* The charge starts at {{fd|0.25}} seconds into the cast time.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* When the dash of the soldiers comes to a halt, all not-yet-affected enemies on top of the soldiers' landing locations (125 radius) are also knocked back.
* ''Emperor's Divide'' will not be canceled if '''Azir''' dies during the cast time.
* While the soldiers are charging forward, the wall is not impassable terrain.
** This means enemies that are immune to {{tip|airborne}} effects can pass through the wall while its moving.
* The wall '''will''' count as terrain for the purposes of 'into terrain' effects (e.g. {{ai|Condemn|Vayne}}, {{ai|Dredge Line|Nautilus}}, {{ai|Heroic Charge|Poppy}}). This will only affect enemies, allies will pass through the wall in all circumstances, even if knocked into it by an enemy.

{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Caitlyn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Count'' {{tip|on-attack}}, doubled if she is within {{tip|brush}}. At 5 stacks, or 4 while in ''brush'', her next basic attack consumes all stacks {{tip|on-attack}} to become a ''Headshot''.
{{sbc|Headshot:}} '''Caitlyn's''' basic attack is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|{{pp|key=%|60 to 100 for 3|1 to 13}}|ad}} {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased to {{as|110% (+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}} against non-champions.
Enemies that step over a ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' or are hit by ''{{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}}'' can grant an additional ''Headshot'' against them at {{sti|range|1300 range}} within {{fd|1.8}} seconds, without consuming stacks. Each method grants only one ''Headshot'' at a time.
Physical
* If '''Caitlyn's''' current target becomes trapped by {{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}} or {{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}} while her attack is on cooldown, this ongoing cooldown will be refunded partially so that her next attack on them can begin earlier.
** Swapping the target to an enemy trapped by {{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}} or {{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}} also reduces her ongoing attack cooldown.
*** {{pending for test}}: The exact attack cooldown refund appears to be 50% of the attack cooldown at current attack speed, but at a minimum amount it lets '''Caitlyn''' start the attack against the trapped target within {{fd|0.5}} seconds of her previous attack windup completing.
* The bonus range from {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}} will not have any effect during {{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn|trap}} and {{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn|net}} extended ''Headshot'' attacks.
* Only the ordinary {{as|100% attack damage}} portion of the attack can critically strike. The bonus from ''Headshot'' is added after the critical strike is rolled.
** The full damage of ''Headshot'' applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
** ''Headshot'' is a single instance of damage, thus does not trigger {{cais|Tantrum|Amumu}} or {{ii|Warden's Mail}} passives twice.
* Since '''Caitlyn's''' Art and Sustainability Update, Ability-granted ''Headshots'' are the same as the original ''Headshot'' override attack, though what lets them cast at high range is still relatively special. They trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects (including stacking ''Headshot'').
** {{Pending for test}} {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}}, is special cased to search targets with the increased range as well.
* Because ''Headshot'' stacks are generated {{tip|on-attack}}, {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nies|Wind's Fury}} bolts will not generate any.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|ward}}s.
** Stacks will still be generated towards ''Headshot'' when attacking them.
}}

''Ace in the Hole'' is placed on a 5-second {{sti|cooldown}} if canceled.
Once '''Caitlyn''' completes the channel, she fires a homing bullet toward the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy champion it hits, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}.

** The target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}.
** '''Caitlyn''' or her target {{tip|death|dies}}.
* ''Ace in the Hole'' reveals the target and '''Caitlyn''' through a buff that lasts for up to 4 seconds.
** The buff is applied to the target from the start of the cast time.
** The buff ends prematurely when the channel is canceled or the bullet hits an enemy.
*** The target is revealed for 1 second if the buff is ended prematurely.
*** It is not removed if the cast time is cancelled or the bullet missile is destroyed.{{bug|2}}
* The bullet missile will fail to hit the primary target if they are {{tip|untargetable}} upon arrival, dealing no damage.
* The ability also goes on a 5-second {{sti|cooldown}} if '''Caitlyn''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during the cast time.
** The cast time does not end prematurely but the channel will be immediately canceled the moment the cast time completes.
* If the target dies after the bullet has been fired, the shot will continue towards their corpse and may still hit other enemy champions.
* The bullet has a {{tip|sight}} radius of 1500 attached to it.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' starts spinning his axe, empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|5.8}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
Upon hitting the target, the axe then ricochets off of them to land after roughly 1.4 seconds, with the location being determined by '''Draven's''' {{tt|current movement|See notes}}. If '''Draven''' catches the axe, he gains ''Spinning Axe's'' empowered attack again.
'''Draven''' can hold up to two ''Spinning Axes'' at once.
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 60}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75 to 115}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{ap|12 to 8}}
45
mana
Physical
* The landing location is determined by '''Draven's''' [[movement speed]] and direction at the time ''Spinning Axe'' hits the target. If '''Draven''' is actually moving, it will bounce directly into his path. Otherwise, it will bounce back towards his current location, either landing directly onto him or to his sides.
* ''Spinning Axe'' will place a visual cue on the ground where it will land. This visual cue is visible to both teams, although '''Draven''' himself will see a more prominent marker.
* Axes take roughly 1.35-1.40s to go from target to landing point. This is not affected by attack speed, movement speed or level.
* Recasting ''Spinning Axe'' will refresh the {{tip|buff}} and add another axe if possible.
** There is no limit to how many axes can be juggled at once, just the limit of 2 of them at a time in '''Draven's''' hands.
* '''Draven''' used to be able to catch (steal) an enemy '''Draven''''s axes. This event also prompted a few unique voice lines.
* ''Spinning Axes'' may optically bypass {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} but they will be destroyed upon collision. {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when {{ci|Braum}} is the target.
* {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when {{ci|Braum}} is not the target.
* The axe will still bounce against parrying effects.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} does not interact with the effects of the axes.
* If a ''Spinning Axe'' is readied during a basic attack wind-up, the effects will be applied to the fired attack.
* ''Spinning Axe'' attacks deal their total increased damage in a single instance of {{tip|basic damage}}.
* ''Spinning Axe'' may fail to properly bounce back if it hits {{ci|Zaahen}} during or shortly after {{ais|Cultivation of War|Zaahen}} revive.{{bug}}
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
** The duration will refresh on-attack against them.
* ''Spinning Axe'' has an indicator that appears on the ground for Draven to stand on. Some skins have a unique indicator.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires an orb in the target direction that marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|structure}} hit for 4 seconds.
His next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--on-hit? on-damage?--> or {{tip|ability}} against the target detonates the mark to deal them {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
If the mark was detonated with an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|60 mana}}}} plus the {{as|mana cost}} of that ability.

8

Mana
Magic
* The application of ''Essence Flux'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage}}.
** This triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]].
** It also triggers {{ri|Sudden Impact}} and applies {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
** It does not trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}, however, as {{tip|proc damage}} doesn't trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}.
* {{tip|Block}} and {{tip|Dodge}} prevents the mark from being triggered by a basic attack.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents the mark from being triggered by an ability. If the mark is triggered by a basic attack, spell shield will prevent ''Essence Flux's'' damage.

{{sbc|Innate - Double Barrel:}} '''Graves'''' {{tip|basic attacks}} fire his shotgun to consume [[ammunition]] within {{as|2 shells|buzzword3}}. He will reload over {{tt|a few seconds|See notes}} immediately after expending all {{as|shells|buzzword3}}, or after withholding a leftover {{as|shell|buzzword3}} {{tt|for a while|See notes}}. The reload time is {{tt|reduced|See notes}} by '''Graves'''' level and {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and is cancelled if '''Graves''' reloads a {{as|shell|buzzword3}} with ''{{ai|Quickdraw|Graves}}'' or expends a leftover {{as|shell|buzzword3}}. '''Graves''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time if he has expended all {{as|shells|buzzword3}}.
{{sbc|Innate - 12-Gauge:}} '''Graves'''' basic attack sprays {{as|4 pellets|buzzword2}} in a cone, each colliding with the first enemy unit in their path, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} plus{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*0.33302}} AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}|about one-third of the damage}}for each subsequent {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} hitting the same target, up to {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*(1+3*0.33302)}} AD}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} against a single target. Pellets deal 25% reduced damage against {{tip|structures}}.
{{tip|Critical strikes}} spray {{as|6 pellets|buzzword2}} over a 25% wider cone, with each {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} dealing{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|50}}|critical damage}} increased damage,|increased damage equal to {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}},}}resulting in{{ft|{{sti|critical damage|{{as|{{ap|((1+({{ccd|Graves|crit_base}}-100)*0.5/100)*(1+5*0.33302)/(1+3*0.33302)*100)|round=3}}% (+ {{ii|Infinity Edge|icononly=true}} {{ap|{{cid|Infinity Edge|critdamage}}*0.5*(1+5*0.33302)/(1+3*0.33302)|round=3}}%)|critical damage}}}} '''total''' damage|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*(1+5*0.33302)*(1+({{ccd|Graves|crit_base}}-100)*0.5/100)}}|AD}} {{as|(+ {{ii|Infinity Edge|icononly=true}} {{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*(1+5*0.33302)*({{cid|Infinity Edge|critdamage}}*0.5/100)}}) AD}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}}}}if all pellets hit a single target.
{{as|Pellets|buzzword2}} {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}. Only the first {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} to hit each enemy applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
{{sbc|Innate - Buckshot:}} Non-champion units hit by more than one {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}, though not through terrain.
Physical
* '''Graves''' takes {{fd|2.08}} seconds to reload 2 shells (when the clip is empty) and {{fd|1.3}} seconds to reload 1 shell. He must idle with 1 shell for {{fd|2.08}} seconds before he starts reloading. These values can be ''improved'' with {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}.
** Values of {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} between {{as|150%|attack speed}} and {{as|200%|attack speed}} have a negative effect on '''Graves' ''' reload speed.
** Attack speed [[growth]] will always have a positive effect on '''Graves' ''' reload speed and is not counted toward the {{as|150%|attack speed}} and {{as|200% attack speed}} thresholds. For example, '''Graves''' gains {{as|{{ap|{{ccd|Graves|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1))}}% bonus attack speed}} from attack speed growth at level 20; meaning the thresholds at level 20 are at {{as|{{ap|150+{{ccd|Graves|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1))}}%|attack speed}} and {{as|{{ap|200+{{ccd|Graves|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1))}}%|attack speed}} respectively.
** Maximum reload speed is {{pplevel|0.65114 to 0.89119|round=3|formula=0.65114 + (0.89119 - 0.65114) / 17 * (x - 1). Formula decimals are estimated to match the ingame rounded values.}}, which equates to a reload timer of {{pplevel|1 / (0.65114 to 0.89119)|formula=1 / Reload Speed Cap.}} seconds, which is the shortest reload time at the 150% threshold.
*** Precise formula is unknown, but it is confirmed to be confusing. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WXmXsCdqAyw&t=520s]
* The in-game HUD for the champion's stat panel incorrectly displays '''Graves''' "reload speed" for reloading 2 shells as his attack speed, instead of displaying his actual attack speed which behaves normally like any other champion. This displayed value more accurately represents his ''reloads per second'', and not ''attacks per second'' as the attack speed tooltip in the HUD would suggest.
* '''Graves''' can hit multiple individual enemies with a single shot from his basic attack. The first pellet hitting an enemy:
** Deals the highest damage out of all other pellets.
** Applies and triggers {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
*** "Single-use" on-hit effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} items will be applied to the very first enemy hit by a pellet (closest one in this case).
** Applies {{tip|basic damage}}, while all additional pellets deal {{tip|default damage}}.
** Is reduced by {{iis|Warden's Mail}} {{nie|Rock Solid}}.
* '''Graves'''' {{tip|attack windup}} is based on such a low value that it will always take only 1 game tick, even at the lowest possible {{as|attack speed}} of {{as|{{fd|0.2}}|attack speed}}.
* When '''Graves''' has his attack range increased by 35% to {{sti|range|{{fd|573.75}}}} via {{iis|Rapid Firecannon}} {{nie|Sharpshooter}}, it has special effects on the cone spread of his basic attack:
** The reach of the individual missiles is also increased by 35% to {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{fd|843.75}} / {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|{{fd|783.75}}|Effective to-edge reach}}.
** The spread of the individual missiles is ''decreased'' by 35% (''angle {{times}} 1/1.35'') to {{tt|{{fd|17.{{recurring|7}}}}{{degree}}|RFC basic attack adjusted spread}} / {{tt|{{fd|22.{{recurring|2}}}}{{degree}}|RFC critical attack adjusted spread}}.
* Pellets will not hit {{tip|wards}} nor [[jungle plants]].
** When '''Graves''' performs a basic attack against these units, he will fire a standard ranged homing missile at the target to successfully hit it.
*** This same missile is also used for when his basic attack is empowered by an {{tip|Energized}} effect.
* Pellets can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, but not missed while '''Graves''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** While '''Graves''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, the pellets are special cased to fire in a random direction that is always away from the primary target of his basic attack.
*** Enemies within range of the pellets in their randomly fired direction will be hit as the pellets cannot be missed.
* {{tip|basic attack reset|Basic attack resets}} other than {{ai|Quickdraw|Graves}} do not affect '''Graves'''' basic attack timer.
* Structures can be hit by multiple pellets, as with other valid targets.
** If '''Graves' ''' basic attack {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} against an enemy behind their structure, and this structure is hit by all pellets, the damage dealt to the structure is increased by {{fd|33.{{recurring|3}}}}%.
* {{tip|On-attack}} effects such as {{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}} and {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} will be triggered as usual from the completion of '''Graves' ''' basic attack windup. They will obey their standard target-acquisition rules in spite of '''Graves' ''' special basic attack behavior.
** {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} can still fire its bolts at secondary targets even if they were already hit by the pellets of '''Graves' ''' basic attack.
* {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}} will be applied for the {{as|physical damage}} dealt by each pellet, meaning that each of '''Graves' ''' basic attacks can apply up to 4 stacks of the effect, increased to the maximum of 5 with a {{tip|critical strike}}.
* {{iis|Sundered Sky}} {{nie|Lightshield Strike}} will function normally with '''Graves' ''' basic attacks, causing the pellets to critically strike if the primary target was also a target of the item's effect.
** If none of the pellets hit the target of ''Lightshield Strike's'' effect, however, the item's effect will not be consumed on the target thus not triggering the heal nor applying the on-target-cooldown, but still causing '''Graves' ''' basic attack to critically strike as if the effect was successfully consumed.
*** His basic attacks against the marked target will be guaranteed to critically strike until the item's effect has been consumed by at least one pellet hitting them.
** Pellets will not consume the item's effect on secondary targets that are also targets of the item's effect; they will not consume the mark of enemies near the primary target that are marked by ''Lightshield Strike''.
* {{iis|Randuin's Omen}} {{nie|Resilience}} will reduce the critical damage dealt by every pellet, resulting in each pellet dealing less damage than if they were to not critically strike.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Cannon.png||{{sbc|Cannon Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|500 attack range}}, and empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} to reduce the target's {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by {{pp|key=%|20 to 35 for 4|1 to 16}} for 5 seconds.
{{Data Jayce/Transform Mercury Hammer|pst2|description2}}
6
* Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The resistance reduction does not apply to structures.
* Both ''Transform'' on-hit effects have no set duration and will only be consumed when ''Jayce'' either lands a basic attack or switches stances.
* The enhanced attack will not be consumed if it is parried ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}, {{tip|blind}}, and {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}).
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

{{sbc|Innate - Death In 4 Acts:}} '''Jhin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} consume [[ammunition]] within 4 rounds. He will reload over {{fd|2.5}} seconds immediately after expending all rounds or withholding leftover rounds after 10 seconds of being [[out of combat]] and not being affected by {{tip|crowd control}}. The latter reload can be interrupted by declaring an attack or casting an ability. '''Jhin''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time.
'''Jhin's''' final round attack has an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, always {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, including against {{tip|turrets|structures}}, and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|15 to 25 for 3|1 to 11}} of the target's {{sti|'''missing''' health}}}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 800 against {{tip|monsters}}.
{{sbc|Innate - Every Moment Matters:}} '''Jhin''' gains {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|4;5;6;7;8;9;10;11;12;14;16;20;24;28;32;36;40;44|formula = 4% at + 1% per level up to 9, then + 2% up to 11, then + 4%, capped at level 18}}|attack damage}}<!--stops at 18-->{{ft|{{as|(+ {{fd|0.35}}% per 1% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.3}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}|{{as|(+ 35% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}{{as|AD}}.
Additionally, {{tip|critical strikes}} against enemies grant '''Jhin''' {{as|14%|movement speed}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.44}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
Physical
* The {{as|{{sti|'''missing''' health}}}} damage benefits from {{sti|life steal}}.
* The '''bonus''' damage based on the target's missing health does not affect structures.
* The 4th attack versus a structure is classified as a critical strike.
* The attack damage multiplier stacks additively with {{bi|Dragon Slayer|Dragon Slayer's}}.
* ''Every Moment Matters' '' bonus {{as|AD}} will benefit from any amount of {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, even in excess of an amount that would usually reach the attacks per second cap ({{fd|3}}).
** The maximum modifier without attack speed is 79%.
*** 44% base modifier at level 18.
*** 35% from critical strike chance on account of the 100% cap.
*** [[Attack speed#Reducing attack speed|Attack speed slows]] will not affect '''Jhin's''' bonus attack damage from his passive and will ignore his attack speed as it is fixed.
* Attack damage reductions apply before the multiplier causing them to be stronger against '''Jhin''' than advertised or versus other champions.
}}

{{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Whenever '''Jhin''' kills an enemy champion, he summons a ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' on their corpse.
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' places a ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location which, upon landing, becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 4 seconds.
'''Jhin''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Lotus Trap'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
''Blooming Lotus Traps'' {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies. ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} as well as against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.
''See [[Jhin#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Lotus Traps.''
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 260}} {{as|(+ 120% AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|20*0.65 to 260*0.65}} {{as|(+ 78% AD)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
2
30
Mana + 1 Charge
Magic
* ''Beauty in Death'' does not consume ''Lotus Trap'' charges.
* The ''Lotus Trap'' will stop upon encountering a {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} or {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* ''Beauty in Death'' does not trigger after killing a {{tip|clone}}.
* The reveal debuff is named [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out''.
** This debuff is shared between ''Captive Audience'' and {{ai|Curtain Call|Jhin}}.
}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Each ''Chomper'' explodes on contact with an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|90 to 290}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{ap|24 to 10}}
90
Mana
Magic
* ''Chompers'' will halt when encountering {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not negate the explosion.
* Each ''Chomper'' gives vision of its surrounding area.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' charges up over the cast time, during which she is still able to move, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{As|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration, with the effectiveness increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed.}}|as}}.
After completing the charge, she gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, during which her attacks have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|(0.1/{{ccd|Kai'Sa|attack_total_time}})*100|round=2}}% and an increased missile speed.
''Supercharge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds {{tip|on-attack}}.
{{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|as|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|key=%|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|as_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack speed}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100% attack speed}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Supercharge'' grants {{tip|invisibility}} at the start of the cast time for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
{{st|Minimum Movement Speed|{{ap|55 to 75}}%|Maximum Movement Speed|{{ap|55*2 to 75*2}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|40 to 80}}%}}
{{ap|16 to 10}}
30
Mana
* Her attack commands during this time are switched to movement commands instead. Upon finishing the charge and if an attack command was issued, '''Kai'Sa''' will continue walking toward her target.
** '''Kai'Sa''' behaves normally if attack move click was issued not on a target during the cast time, stopping at attack range of the closest target and starts attacking when charged up.

{{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Kalista''' inputs a {{tt|movement command|Default MB2/right click}} during her {{tip|attack windup|basic attack windup}} or shortly after it completes, or while in cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'', she will {{tip|dash}} in that direction.

'''''Kalista''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, and she will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.'' ''Martial Poise'''s dash range and speed details: * Dash range of basic attacks is modified by the tier of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]] and the angle of the dash. ** At a 0° angle towards the target, the minimum dash range is {{pp|140;153;166;175|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units. ** At a 90° angle, the maximum dash range is {{pp|240;263;280;300|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units. * Dash range of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' is 300 units when dashing anywhere in the direction of the point of cast. ** If the dash is inputted to a location that is ''away'' from ''{{ais|Pierce|Kalista}}'' point of cast, the dash range is reduced based on the angle, with a minimum distance of 150 units if the inputted location is {{tt|directly opposite|Backwards dash}}. * Dash speed is increased based on the {{tt|tier|+75 for Boots and +135 for finished Boots}} of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]], and is affected by her {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} modifiers she is under the effect of (including {{tip|slow|slows}}). {{sbc|Innate - Oathsworn Bond:}} '''Kalista''' begins the game with an exclusive ''{{ii|Black Spear}}'' that she can activate on an allied champion to deem them ''Oathsworn'', forming a {{tip|tether}} together. While she and the ally bound as the ''Oathsworn'' are within tether range of each other, they can both interact with ''{{ai|Sentinel 3|Kalista|Soul-Mark}}'' and ''{{ai|Fate's Call|Kalista}}''. '''''Kalista''' can purchase the {{ii|Black Spear}} from the [[shop]] at no cost to obtain it again and, before 3 minutes of game time, may activate the item again on a different target to designate a new Oathsworn. See {{ii|Black Spear}} for more details.'' * Basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' cannot be cast while dashing, unless animation cancelled with a movement command. * '''Kalista''' must wait for her auto attack windup or cast animation to finish, before she dashes. However, '''Kalista''' will dash immediately if the movement command to dash is input after her auto attack windup finishes. * {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} also "remembers" your auto attack target after dashing, letting you dash repeatedly by only clicking the ground. * {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} cannot keep up with attack speed values greater than {{fd|2.1}}, due to the combination of her auto attack windup taking too long, and her dashes being too slow. Movement speed bonuses make it less of an issue. ** Sufficiently high attack speeds can also cause {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} to interpret movement inputs as dash inputs, during the dash of a previous auto attack (such as jumping towards attack-move inputs). * Move commands inputted during an attack windup or the cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' while '''Kalista''' is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} will fail to cast and thus prevent the dash from triggering. * If multiple move commands are inputted during the attack windup, the most recent one is used for the dash's targeting. ** If the most recent input is not a move command, the dash will not trigger. *** In this case, the buffer for the previous move command was cancelled by a new non-move command such as an input for an attack or ability cast. ** The move command will still be buffered to the end of the immobilization or the end of the attack windup or cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' while grounded if it has not been overridden by other inputs. * '''Kalista's''' facing direction will change immediately on move command even among multiple inputs, but will not visually update until the dash. * The facing direction when dashing is considered to be in the direction of the dash, not her apparent facing direction based on her model's animation state. * Dash distance decreases as the dash direction becomes closer to the minimum direction. This defines a forward distance for basic attacks and a backwards distance for {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}.
Empirical testing has given the following values below. ** Basic attack dash range given the angle θ: *** \begin{cases}(175 + (125 \times \sin(\theta))) \times T \end{cases} **** Where T = 0.800, 0.875, 0.950, 1.000 depending on the tier of Boots (T0, T1, T2, T3) *** Minimum dash range of 225 units when dashing backwards ** ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista|Pierce's}}'' dash range given the angle θ: *** \begin{cases} 150 + (150 \times \sin(\theta)) & \mathrm{Backwards} \\ 300 & \mathrm{Otherwise} \end{cases} * There is a very brief grace period after completing a basic attack windup wherein '''Kalista''' can still input a movement command to trigger the dash. * The dash speed is unaffected by additive movement speed modifiers. * There are a total of 24 different dash ranges based on direction with {{ig|Boots}} and {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}} being cast. * '''Kalista''' will automatically be issued an attack command on her attack target at the end of the dash, as long as they remain in her attack range by then. * The attack move (default {{sbc|A + MB1}}) click feature checks for targets in brief intervals only if '''Kalista''' is not dashing. * {{tip|Sleep}} does not count for knocking the dash down.{{bug}}

{{sbc|Passive - Soul-Marked:}} While '''Kalista''' and her ''{{ii|The Black Spear|Oathsworn}}'' are {{tip|tether|tethered}}, their basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a ''Soul-Mark'' to the target hit for 4 seconds.
If both '''Kalista's''' and the ''Oathsworn's'' ''Soul-Mark'' are applied to the same enemy, the marks are consumed to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target, capped against non-champions. ''Soul-Mark'' cannot affect an enemy more than once every few seconds.
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' summons a ''Sentinel'' that patrols back and forth on a path along the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings as it travels.
'''Kalista''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Sentinel'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
''See [[Kalista#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Sentinels.''
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 18}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
{{st|Maximum Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}}}}
30
magic
* The damage is dealt {{tip|on-attack}} of '''Kalista's''' basic attack if she applies the second mark. If the ''Oathsworn'' does so instead, the damage is dealt [[on-hit]] of their basic attack.
* ''Soul-Marked's'' bonus damage is credited to '''Kalista''' and will benefit from both her {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic penetration}}}} and [[spell effects]].
** If her {{ii|The Black Spear|Oathsworn}} ally scores a kill using ''Soul-Marked's'' bonus damage they will get a message stating 'Kill Secured' in place of the usual gold pop-up (the gold itself is credited to '''Kalista''').
* The ''Sentinel's'' {{tip|sight}} reveal on enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} is accredited for [[assist|assists]] and potentially [[kill|kills]] (if they die shortly after being spotted).
** It does not reveal {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} targets.
* ''Sentinel'' will cast from wherever '''Kalista''' is at the end of the cast time.
* {{Pending for test}} ''Soul Mark's'' interaction with ''parrying'' effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}, {{tip|blind}}).
* {{pending for test}} If ''Pierce'' kills the target by ''Soul-Mark's'' additional damage, it will/will not continue.
}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' invokes her {{ii|The Black Spear|tether}} to retrieve and hold her ''Oathsworn'' for 4 seconds. '''Kalista''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} the ''Oathsworn'' from all {{tip|crowd control}} and renders them {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for the duration, and {{tip|dash|pulls}} them to her over 1 second.
While held, the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|vanish|vanished}} and may {{tt|select|Default MB1 / left-click}} a target location to {{tip|dash}} to with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, ending ''Fate's Call's'' invocation and reappearing at the location. If the invocation ends without the ''Oathsworn'' selecting a target location, they will automatically do so at maximum range from '''Kalista's''' facing direction.
The ''Oathsworn's'' dash stops upon colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}}. Upon the dash ending by collision or arriving to the targeted location, the ''Oathsworn'' {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} all nearby enemies and keeps them {{tip|airborne}} for a set duration, while simultaneously {{tip|lunge|landing}} to their {{sti|attack range|'''base''' attack range}} {{tt|from the closest target hit|See notes}}.
''The Oathsworn must be within tether range to cast this ability, and is also {{tip|silence|silenced}} and unable to perform movement or attack commands while Fate's Call is in effect.''
{{st|Airborne Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
{{ap|160 to 120}}
100
mana
* The ''Oathsworn's'' landing location of the lunge is precisely to their base attack range from the closest target they hit and relative to where this target would be displaced to from the knock back.
** In other words, the ''Oathsworn'' will land to a location where they are within their exact base attack range of the target by the end of the target's displacement.
** The calculated landing spot does not evaluate if the target was successfully displaced or not, meaning that the ''Oathsworn'' will end up closer than their base attack range if the closest target hit was not knocked back.
* The {{tip|airborne}} effect is attributed to ''Fate's Call's'' initial caster.
* If the ''Oathsworn'' does not hit any targets with the knock up effect, the dash will simply end and they will reappear at the target location.
* '''Kalista''' is briefly unable to start basic attacks or cast basic abilities when the ''Oathsworn'' starts their flight.
* The following will defer ''Fate's Call's'' effects at the time of cast to the end of their duration if the ''Oathsworn'' is:
** In a [[cast time]].
** {{tip|Channel|Channeling}}.
*** ''Fate's Call'' will not defer by the following channels: {{si|Recall}}, {{ai|Defiant Dance|Irelia}}, {{ai|Realm Warp|Ryze}}, and {{ai|The Culling|Lucian}}.
*** ''Fate's Call'' cannot be cast during the following channels: {{si|Teleport}}, {{ai|Gate|Twisted Fate}}, {{ai|Grand Starfall|Pantheon}}, {{ai|Hero's Entrance|Galio}} and {{ai|Stand United|Shen}}.
** Using an ability that preloads {{tip|unstoppableforcemarker|UnstoppableForceMarker}}.
*** If the ''Oathsworn'' is still occupied after 6 seconds of being deferred from this time, ''Fate's Call'' will cancel.
* ''Fate's Call'' will not pull the ''Oathsworn'' if they are {{tip|dash|dashing}} but they will be retrieved after 1 second regardless.
* ''Fate's Call'' can be cast even if the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Fate's Call'' is disabled if the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}} or is being affected by another ''Fate's Call''.
* ''Fate's Call'' can be used even if the ''Oathsworn'' is in a {{tip|zombie state}}.
* ''Fate's Call'' does not render the target {{tip|vanish|vanished}} while being held if they are creating {{ais|E|Senna}} aura.
* The ''Oathsworn'' being held is represented by a light over '''Kalista's''' head.
* '''Kalista's''' [[death]] does not cancel ''Fate's Call''.

{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kayle''' ascends through four forms that each grant additional bonuses. She ascends upon spending a skill point at {{stil|experience|levels}} 1, 6, 11, and 16.
{{sbc|Level 1 - Zealous:}} '''Kayle's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Zeal'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 5 times. For each stack, she gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|6%|attack speed}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{sti|attack speed|{{as|30%|attack speed}}}}. At max stacks, she becomes ''Exalted'', gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
{{sbc|Level 6 - Arisen:}} '''Kayle''' becomes {{tip|ranged}} and gains {{sti|range|350 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|525}}.
{{sbc|Level 11 - Aflame:}} '''Kayle''' gains 10% bonus {{tip|size}}. While '''Kayle''' is ''Exalted'', her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} also launch a ''wave'' of fire forward that deals {{pplevel|20+3*(x-1)|11+x-1|formula=20 + 3 for every  level starting from level 11|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies it passes through. The ''wave'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
{{sbc|Level 16 - Transcendent:}} '''Kayle''' gains an additional {{sti|range|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|625}}, and permanently gains the full effects of ''Zealous''.
magic
'''Zealous'''
* The stacking {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} can be tracked on the HUD via a buff called [[File:Kayle Divine Ascent 2.png|20px|link=]] '''Zeal''', while the maximum stacks bonus grants the buff [[File:Kayle Divine Ascent.png|20px|link=]] '''Exalted'''.
* Subsequent applications will also refresh the duration of all stacks, but all of them are lost when expired.
* If '''Kayle''' is in her attack animation after the stacks expire, she gains another {{fd|0.5}} seconds to refresh/stack [[File:Kayle Divine Ascent 2.png|20px|link=]] '''Zeal'''.
'''Arisen'''
* Basic attacks within {{sti|range|175 units}} will still use '''Kayle's''' melee basic attack animations and do not utilize {{tip|projectile|projectiles}}.
** They are still classified as {{tip|ranged}} attacks.
** Due to this fact, projectile-blocking effects cannot intercept basic attacks while '''Kayle's''' target is within her "melee" range.
'''Aflame'''
* On becoming {{sbc|Aflame}}, '''Kayle's''' bonus size grows linearly over 1 second.
* Basic attacks against [[structures]] do not trigger fire waves.
* While at 4 stacks of [[File:Kayle Divine Ascent 2.png|20px|link=]] '''Zeal''', the next attack {{tip|on-attack}} reaching the fifth stack will be empowered by {{sbc|Aflame}}, releasing the first fire wave.
'''Transcendent'''
* The [[File:Kayle Divine Ascent 2.png|20px|link=]] '''Zeal''' and [[File:Kayle Divine Ascent.png|20px|link=]] '''Exalted''' buffs are replaced by a new buff that grants the benefits of both and it is not visible on '''Kayle's ''' HUD.
'''Fire Waves Details'''
* [[File:Celestine Wish Kayle Fire Wave.png|thumb|Hitboxes shows by a graph side by side.]] A wave consists of three projectiles for the hitbox and a fourth for visuals.
* The hitbox projectiles spawn 75 units behind '''Kayle''', travel through her, and are destroyed once they've traveled 850 units. Their technical details are:
** {{sbc|Range:}} {{tip|cr|850}} (755 effective)
** {{sbc|Width:}} {{tip|er|200}}
** {{sbc|Projectile Speed:}} 2800
** {{sbc|Angle:}} 18{{degree}} (left and right at 9{{degree}} to their side, respectively)
* The distance of the fire waves scales with '''bonus''' attack range.
* {{tip|Projectile}}-blocking effects can block each projectile individually.
** It is possible to block the visuals, but still get hit by an unblocked "invisible" hitbox projectile.
* Hitting an enemy with multiple projectiles of the same wave will not increase the damage dealt.
* The fire wave shares {{tip|cast instance}} with the triggering basic attack.
** The amount of {{ri|Conqueror}} stacks gained will be {{rd|2|1}} if the basic attack deals damage first or 2 if the wave does so.
* Keep in mind that it's still two damage instances. If one triggers {{ri|Bone Plating}}, the other's damage will be blocked.
* Fire waves roll {{tip|critical strike|critical strike chance}} on each target hit individually.
* A known issue is that despite dealing {{tip|area damage|area spell damage}} the fire wave does not:
** Consume {{nie|Mana Charge}} from {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}} and its upgrades.
** Trigger {{ri|Manaflow Band}}.
'''Interactions & Other'''
* Because '''Kayle''' is both a {{tip|melee}} and {{tip|ranged}} champion, she can purchase both ranged and melee exclusive items at anytime, but their effects will function depending on her current range type; the same principle also applies to [[runes]].
** However, keep in mind that, prior to ascending to ''Arisen'', {{ai|Starfire Spellblade|Kayle}} also changes this behaviour based on its usage.
* Waves are fired in the direction that '''Kayle''' is facing. Changing that during the attack windup via {{si|Flash}} will also change the direction of the wave.
* Each ascension has an unique animation and a voice line. ''([[Kayle/LoL/Audio|See: Kayle's quotes]])''
* The ascensions' animation will override the current one, but it does not cancel '''Kayle's''' current action, nor her previous orders.

candidates.sourceText: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' conjures a portal in front of her that faces the target direction, from which, after 0.25 seconds, a celestial sword launches forward. The sword expands upon hitting an enemy, with targets struck in the area dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 2 seconds, and inflicted with 15% '''reduced''' {{sti|armor|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds. {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}} {{st|Slow|{{ap|25 to 45}}%}} {{ap|12 to 8}} {{ap|60 to 100}} Mana Magic '''Details''' * This ability has a cast time and cast delay. The former represents the amount of time Kayle needs to spend to cast and is equal to her attack windup time. The latter is the amount of time the portal needs to launch the sword, which is always {{rutngt|0.25}} seconds, starting from the beginning of the cast time. ** As implied by the previous point, the portal is created at the start of the cast time and '''Kayle''' does not have to be alive for it to launch the sword. ** The portal does not follow '''Kayle's''' movements, using {{si|Flash}} or getting displaced won't change its position nor direction either. * The cast time can be calculated by dividing '''Kayle's''' ''windup percent'' value ({{fd|0.193555}}) with her current total attack speed. ** ''Radiant Blast's'' cast time is {{rutngt|0.30968}} at base attack speed, is at most {{rutngt|0.96775}} at the minimum attack speed of {{sti|attack speed|{{as|0.2|attack speed}}}}, and is {{rutngt|0.06445}} at the attack speed cap of {{sti|attack speed|{{as|3.003|attack speed}}}}. The cast time can be further decreased with effects that allows the player to bypass the attack speed cap. ** Additionally, it should be noted that due to action only taking place on whole game ticks, the cast time can only be changed in fractions of {{fd|0.033}} seconds. This also means that the lowest possible cast time is {{fd|0.033}} seconds, requiring at least {{sti|attack speed|{{as|5.8652|attack speed}}}} attack speed. ** {{Note|1}} Important to note that in patch [[V9.17]], ''Radiant Blast's'' cast time was changed to be a flat {{fd|0.25}} seconds, rather than scaling with the attack windup time. In patch [[V10.4]], this was undocumentedly changed back. Whether the change to scale with windup time again was intentional or not is unknown. * The resistance reduction is applied after the damage has been dealt. * The expansion consists of 5 hitboxes, forming a cross-like shape centered 100 units ahead from the impact in its direction. Their technical details can be seen below and visualized on the image to the right. [[File:Celestine Wish Kayle_Q_Explosion.png|thumb|The left side shows projectile's width and the total area traveled if it does not hit a target, while the right side shows the explosions when it hits a target.]] ** ExplosionCenter: 100 radius ** ExplosionLeft: 150 distance, 125 width ** ExplosionRight: 150 distance, 125 width ** ExplosionBackward: 100 distance, 90 width ** ExplosionForward: 400 distance, 90 width '''Interactions & Other''' * The visual effects of the explosion shows the blade and guard of '''Kayle's''' swords. * The resistance reduction can be tracked on the HUD as a debuff called [[File: Radiant Blast 2.png|20px|link=]] '''Sundered'''. * {{Note|1}} Note that the [[File:Kayle PsyOpsCircle.png|32px]] PsyOps skin still uses the old shred VFX, which also only shows for 3 seconds (effect duration is not affected). This is possibly an oversight as all existing, and at the time released Dragon Slayer, skins were updated properly in [[V11.18]]. [[File:Celestine_Wish_Kayle_PsyOps_Shred_Indicator_Issue.mp4]]

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' kindles her blade, empowering her next [[basic attack]] within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal additional {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} that is capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}. If '''Kayle''' is not yet ''{{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle|Arisen}}'', this attack becomes {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|range|525 range}}.
{{sbc|{{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle|Aflame}} Bonus:}} The attack explodes upon the target, dealing its damage to surrounding enemies and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. This is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
''Starfire Spellblade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kayle's''' basic attack timer. Starfire Spellblade does not deal bonus damage against [[structure|structures]].''
{{st|Passive Damage|{{ap|15 to 35}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}

'''Details'''
* ''Starfire Spellblade'' deals:
** The physical damage part of both the attack and the explosion deals {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}.
** {{Tip|Proc damage}} for the passive's {{tip|on-hit}} effect.
** {{Tip|Proc damage}} for the active's {{tip|on-hit}} effect.
** All damage dealt to secondary targets by the explosion is additionally tagged as {{tip|area damage}}.
* The active's effect shares the same {{tip|cast instance}} with the triggering attack (exception: {{ii|Muramana}}, see '''Interactions & Other''').
* Parry interactions:
** {{tip|Blind}}: The main target will never receive damage, but the secondary targets will receive the active's spell damage.
** {{tip|Block}}: Blocking will always negate all damage. Keep in mind that if a secondary target is outside of {{ais|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}} zone, they won't block damage.
** {{tip|Dodge}}: Dodging will always negate all damage.
* {{pending for test}}: All parry interactions are marked for retesting because of patch [[V11.1]] changes.
'''Interactions & Other'''
* While the active's effect is up, a circle is visible to '''Kayle''', indicating her {{sti|range}}, however, this circle only takes into account {{ais|Divine Ascent|Kayle}} effect on her range, not other sources such as {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.
** The increased range (with the item's effect included) will be {{sti|range|675}} prior to ascending to {{sbc|Transcendent}}, after which it's {{sti|range|725}}.
* To clarify the description, ''Starfire Spellblade'' can behave both as a {{tip|ranged}} and {{tip|melee}} attack based on how far the target is prior to '''Kayle''' ascending to {{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle|Arisen}}, after which the attack will be always using ranged standards.
** If the target is 200 units away or closer, the attack will be considered melee. This also uses her melee animations, not utilizing projectiles even after ascending.
** If the target is over 200 units, the attack will be considered ranged.
* To further expand on this: Using the ranged empowered attack will change '''Kayle's''' range type to ranged while the projectile is alive. This means that if the target could outrun the projectile, '''Kayle''' would be stuck on being ranged, although the bonuses from the active are not kept. While it's unlikely to be on this temporary ranged state for longer than half a seconds during a normal playthrough, it is possible to achieve few seconds when specific conditions are met.
* Keep in mind that while on-hit effects will be applied to all targets in the explosion, {{tip|on-attack}} effects are only applied once per basic attack, not per target hit.
* Single-use on-hits, such as {{tip|Spellblade}}, will be applied to the main target.
** If the main target died prior to the projectile reaching them, or if it was a [[Jungle plants|jungle plant]], the effects will be applied to the closest target from the explosion's center.
* {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} {{nie|Phantom Hit}} can only be applied to the main target.
* Despite being one cast instance, ''Starfire Spellblade'' triggers {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}} twice on each target, dealing normal bonus damage after the basic attack and increased bonus damage after the spell, totalling at {{as|{{as|{{rd|{{fd|5.2}}%|{{fd|4.2}}%}} '''maximum''' mana}} '''bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' grants herself or a target allied champion {{tip|invulnerable|invulnerability}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds from the start of the cast time, and conjures flaming swords around herself.
After {{fd|2.5}} seconds, she rains the swords down around the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
'''''Kayle''' can move during Divine Judgment's cast time.''
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{tt|{{ap|160 to 80}}|Begins at the start of cast time}}
{{ap|100 to 0}}
mana
Magic
'''Details'''
* ''Divine Judgment's'' effects persist through the target's {{tip|death}}.
* ''Divine Judgment'' will prioritize casting on allies over '''Kayle'''. This means that if the player is [[unit selection|selecting]] a point with the mouse on which both '''Kayle's''' and another valid target's selection areas overlap on the map, the cast will always occur on the ally.
* Prior to becoming {{sbc|Transcended}} via {{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle}}, casting ''Divine Judgment'' refreshes the duration of {{ai|Divine Ascent 2|Kayle|Zeal}}  stacks at the start of the cast time to ensure that it does not expire while she can't attack during the cast.
* During cast, an indicator for the damaging area can be seen around the target, however, this is not visible if there is no {{tip|sight}} on the them.
* ''Divine Judgment'' can be cast on {{tip|clone|clones}} too, including {{ai|Shapesplitter|Neeko}} and {{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong}}, which are normally not targetable for allies. <!-- From "untargetable" to "not targetable", since these are not the same effects. Important! -->
* While it's an uncommon occurence, it is possible to cast ''Divine Judgment'' on targets who just entered {{tip|resurrection}} or {{tip|zombie state}}. This is only possible with very strict timing and perhaps high latency.
* It's recommended to avoid both of the afformentioned interactions, as they render the usage of ''Divine Judgment'' useless in many cases.
'''Interactions & Other'''
* While the target is invulnerable, a number indicator will appear beneath them whenever they would receive damage to show the amount that was entirely mitigated. This is calculated pre-mitigation, meaning before resistances and reductions are taken into account.
* {{iis|Rapid Firecannon}} {{nie|Energized}} effect behaves strangely with the set basic attack range:
** If the ability is cast while the effect is ready, the range goes from {{sti|range|400}} to {{sti|range|385}} over 4 {{tt|stat updates|A stat update occurs every 0.264 seconds.}} (400 -> 390 -> 387 -> 385). When the cast completes, the proper range needs 2 updates to set in ({{sti|range|660}} - {{sti|range|675}} while {{sbc|Arisen}}; {{sti|range|710}} - {{sti|range|725}} while {{sbc|Transcended}}).
** Gaining the effect during the cast will cause the range to cycle between {{sti|range|525}} and {{sti|range|550}} until the cast finishes, then the proper range is set after 1 update.
** Selling the item during the cast causes the range to be set to {{sti|range|250}}.
{{pending for test}} Range values are outdated because of patch [[V11.18]] changes to '''Kayle'''.
* The invulnerability can be tracked on the HUD via a buff called [[File:Divine Judgment.png|20px|link=]] '''Intervention'''.

{{sbc|Innate:}} Both '''Lamb''' and '''Wolf''' mark targets to ''hunt''. Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''.

{{sbc|Mark of the Kindred:}} '''Lamb''' gains {{pp|type=marks|75;100;125;150;175;200;225;250|4;7;10;13;16;19;22;25|formula=+75 at 4 stacks, and +25 every 3 stacks thereafter, up to 250 bonus range at 25 stacks.}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''. {{sbc|Innate - Lamb:}} '''Lamb''' is offered a selection of enemy {{tip|champions}} to ''hunt'' if she has not been [[combat status|in combat]] with them in the last 6 seconds. Once selected, the mark is applied after an 8-second delay and thereafter it can be collected by '''Kindred'''. '''Lamb''' gains the ability to select a new target every 75 seconds. ''Targets successfully hunted cannot be marked again for 4 minutes.'' {{sbc|Innate - Wolf:}} Starting at {{sbc|2:53}}, '''Wolf''' periodically marks a random large {{tip|monster}} within the enemy team's jungle for 180 seconds. The ''hunted'' camp is highlighted on the [[Map (League of Legends)|mini map]] to both teams. Once the ''hunted'' target is slain or the mark expires, '''Wolf''' will wait 45 seconds before selecting a new target.
The type of monster that '''Wolf''' can mark changes based on '''Kindred's''' current ''Mark of the Kindred'' stacks: * {{sbc|0 :}} {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} * {{sbc|1 – 3:}} {{ui|Rift Scuttler}}, {{ui|Crimson Raptor}}, {{ui|Gromp}} * {{sbc|4 – 7:}} {{ui|Ancient Krug}}, {{ui|Blue Sentinel}}, {{ui|Greater Murk Wolf}}, or {{ui|Red Brambleback}} * {{sbc|8 + :}} {{ui|Rift Herald}} or {{ui|Baron Nashor}}, {{ui|Dragon}} or {{ui|Elder Dragon}} * The selection of enemy champions to mark is offered through a special menu in the HUD that displays the portraits of up to 5 enemy champions. The player can mark an enemy by {{LMB}} clicking on their portrait or via the Champion Specific Interaction [[hotkey]]s (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F1–F5}}). ** Marked enemies have a trim around their portrait. Unavailable selections are greyed out. ** The portraits are ordered based on their spawn ID. * {{tip|Takedown|Takedowns}} on {{tip|monsters}} occur if '''Kindred''' had damaged them within the last 6 seconds. ** This only includes if the monster was slain by '''Kindred''' or an ally. * Only killing the large monster is required to claim '''Wolf's''' mark. * Gaining stacks from champions that would change what constitutes a valid target for '''Wolf''' will not affect '''Kindred's''' ability to claim '''Wolf's''' current target. * '''Wolf''' cannot mark monsters that have been slain, even if '''Kindred's''' team doesn't know that the camp has been slain. * '''Wolf's''' cooldown is not displayed in-game. Combined with the above point and the target restrictions, '''Wolf''' may go extended periods of time without seeming to do anything. * '''Wolf's''' marked target will always have its mark removed from the map 15 seconds after dying for both teams, regardless of whether they have vision of it or not.

The heal is not triggered if '''Kindred''' is at full health.
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Wolf''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, then claims the surrounding area as his territory for the next {{fd|8.5}} seconds, separating from '''Lamb'''. He automatically attacks the closest nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within the area, prioritizing the last enemy '''Lamb''' has attacked, then enemy champions, then non-champions.
'''Wolf's''' attacks deal {{as|magic damage}} and the rate at which he attacks scale with {{as|25% of '''Kindred's bonus''' attack speed}}. Against monsters, his attacks deal 150% damage and {{tip|slow}} the target by 50% for 2 seconds. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{fd|112.5}} {{as|(+ 15 per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} against monsters.
''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% {{as|(+ 1% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}|Monster Damage|{{ap|25*1.5 to 45*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*1.5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*1.5}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
