* ''Hunter's Vigor's'' heal is not triggered on attacks against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
* '''Wolf''' is {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} but he cannot move through terrain other than the initial dash on activation.
* '''Wolf''' is not able to re-target {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} if he loses {{tip|sight}} of her while he's attacking it.
* '''Wolf''' grants the same {{tip|sight|vision}} as a {{tip|champion}}.
* ''Wolf's Frenzy'' does not end if '''Lamb''' enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
* ''Wolf's Frenzy'' applies ability haste to its cooldown post-effect.
** Given a base cooldown of 14 seconds at rank 5 with 100 ability haste, casting the ability and then ending it after 4 seconds will result in a remaining cooldown of <math>(14 - 4) \times 0.5 = 5</math> seconds, where 0.5 is [[Haste#Formula|derived from ability haste]].
** Because of this, there will always be some cooldown time remaining post-effect regardless of the amount of ability haste, unlike certain other abilities with cooldowns that start on-cast.

{{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Lucian's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|3.5}} seconds fires an additional shot {{tip|on-attack}} after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 60|1;7;13}} AD {{as|physical damage}}}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}. He will shoot the same target, else another target within 50 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}} automatically.
The second shot {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
{{sbc|Innate - Vigilance:}} Whenever '''Lucian''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} or {{tip|shield|shielded}} by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is {{tip|immobilized}}, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. He can store up to 4 empowered shots at a time.
Physical
* ''Lightslinger'' is triggered and consumed by the first attack, even if no target can be found upon firing the second attack.
* The second attack, if the initial target was killed, will prioritize enemy champions regardless of having {{tip|sight}} of them or not and enemy {{tip|minion|minions}} with {{sti|health|{{as|low health}}}}.
* '''Lucian''' can perform actions freely while firing ''Lightslinger's'' second attack.
** The second attack has special movement animations depending on the direction '''Lucian''' is moving while firing.
* The second attack counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* The second attack separately rolls a {{tip|critical strike}}.
* The second attack does not trigger {{iis|Sundered Sky}} {{nie|Lightshield Strike}}.{{bug|2}}
* The empowered shots will apply against structures.
}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' {{tip|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, rapidly firing up to 22 {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 22.222|flat=true|round=floor|critScaling=true}})|crit chance}} shots in the target direction over the duration. Each shot deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}. ''The Culling'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends.
While channeling, '''Lucian''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and may still move.
{{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lucian''' ends ''The Culling''.
{{st|Physical Damage Per Shot|{{ap|{{#var:r_d1}} to {{#var:r_d3}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:r_ad}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#var:r_ap}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage Per Shot|{{ap|({{#var:r_d1}} to {{#var:r_d3}})*{{#var:r_dm}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ad}}*{{#var:r_dm}}}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ap}}*{{#var:r_dm}}}}% AP)}}}}
{{ap|110 to 90}}
100
Mana
Physical
* ''The Culling'' creates the shots at an offset of 35 units to the front plus 35 units towards each side of '''Lucian''' (sides alternating, first shot fired from '''Lucian's''' right gun), unlike the missiles of most abilities.
<!--{{#vardefine:r_max|{{#expr: 100/{{#var:r_c}}+{{#var:r_ts}}}}}}<!-- (DO NOT MODIFY) -->
<!--* At {{as|100% critical strike chance}}, ''The Culling'' fires up to {{ap|100/{{#var:r_c}}}} additional shots, for a total of {{#var:r_max}} shots.
** The '''total''' damage at the maximum number of shots (at {{as|100% critical strike chance}}) is {{as|{{ap|({{#var:r_d1}} to {{#var:r_d3}})*{{#var:r_max}}}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ad}}*{{#var:r_max}}}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ap}}*{{#var:r_max}}}}% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}}.
** Against minions, this is increased to {{as|{{ap|({{#var:r_d1}} to {{#var:r_d3}})*{{#var:r_max}}*{{#var:r_dm}}}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ad}}*{{#var:r_max}}*{{#var:r_dm}}}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ap}}*{{#var:r_max}}*{{#var:r_dm}}}}% AP)}}.-->
* The fire rate increases with the number of shots.
* During ''The Culling'', '''Lucian's''' facing direction is in the direction that he is firing.
* '''Lucian''' can interact with {{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}} or allied {{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}} without {{tip|interrupt|interrupting}} ''The Culling''.
* The damage dealt by each bullet of ''The Culling'' is calculated when the bullet reaches a target, just like single missile abilities.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} only blocks one instance of damage.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Lucian''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|cast={{ai|Relentless Pursuit|Lucian}} is usable. {{ai|Piercing Light|Lucian}} and {{ai|Ardent Blaze|Lucian}} are disabled. This ability recasts to end channel.|move=true|items=true,true,interrupts,true,true|attack=false|spells=true,true,true,false,false}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the primary target and {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will {{tip|critically strike}}.
''The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the bounce.''
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
{{ap|7 to 3}}
40
Mana
Physical
* ''Double Up'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} to both targets, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} can be used by either target. If it is on the primary target, the spell shield will not prevent the shot from bouncing.
* Neutral units count as valid targets to bounce.
* The bounce follows a priority order on targets behind in a certain angle:
*# 500 units in 20º.
*# 500 units in 40º.
*# 500 units in 110º.
*# {{tt|150 units|Estimated}} in 160º.
* ''Double Up's'' cast range adjusts based on '''Miss Fortune's''' {{sti|attack range}}, which can be increased by items such as {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.
* The damage of a {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} shot is {{ap|20*1.5 to 120*1.5}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}} {{as|(+ 52.5% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{ap|20*1.65 to 120*1.65}} {{as|(+ 165% AD)}} {{as|(+ 57.75% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} by {{iis|Infinity Edge}} bonus critical damage.
* If there is no secondary target, the shot will not bounce and the dud will instead fall to the ground.
** The dud lands on the ground 176 units behind the primary target and has a missile speed of 400 on its way there.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}

{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Quinn's''' ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' against the primary target, ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'', and ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}'' mark enemies hit with ''Harrier'' for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''{{ci|Valor}}''' will periodically mark a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy if no ''Harrier'' targets exist for 1 second.
'''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against ''Harrier'' targets are empowered to consume the mark to deal {{pp|15 + (120-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
''Harrier'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
While ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' is active, ''Harrier'' is disabled and all ''Harrier'' marks are removed.
Physical
* If a mark applied by an ability is overwritten, consumed, or timed out, ''Harrier'' goes on a 1-second cooldown if it's not already on cooldown.
* ''Harrier's'' targeting priority:
*# Last unit hit (if it was a small minion it appears to select a different target).
*# Lowest-health enemy champion.
*# Lowest-health enemy minion.
* ''Harrier'' is consumed even if it is parried, the attack is negated in any case.
* ''Harrier'' will not mark enemy {{tip|minions}} while '''Quinn''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}}, but will mark enemy {{tip|champions}}.
}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|channels}} for 2 seconds, signaling '''{{ci|Valor}}''' to pair up. Upon completion, he picks her up and they unite, increasing her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|'''total''' movement speed|Increases base movement as well as bonus movement speed}}}}}}, granting her {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}}, and allowing her to cast ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''. ''Behind Enemy Lines'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel.
Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} while ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is active or while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} the ability causes her to lose the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. Becoming {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} ends ''Behind Enemy Lines'' immediately and puts it on {{sti|cooldown}} without performing ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.
Once ''Behind Enemy Lines'' has been learned, [[death|respawning]] or entering {{tt|any|see notes}} [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' instantly.
{{sbc|Recast:}} '''Quinn''' cancels the channel, placing ''Behind Enemy Lines'' on cooldown.
{{st|Total Movement Speed Increase|{{ap|70 to 130}}%}}
3
{{ap|50 to 0}}
Mana
* Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} removes the bonus movement speed buff temporarily by suppressing it with the status effect of a {{tip|slow}}.
** This slow is not affected by {{tip|slow resist}} or {{tip|slow immunity}}, but it can be {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}}.
** While the slow is in effect, ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not considered to grant increased {{as|movement speed}} for the purpose of {{ri|Celerity}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' does not refund its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if the channel was canceled via recast.
** The only exception is if '''Quinn's''' {{as|mana}} falls below the {{as|mana cost}}, in which case she is granted enough {{as|mana}} back (the equal amount needed) to be able to cast ''Behind Enemy Lines'' again.
* [[death|Respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will not spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' if ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is on cooldown.
* If '''{{ci|Valor}}''' is spawned by [[death|respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]], {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} will be disabled from being manually cast for {{fd|2.5}} seconds upon uniting. However, it will still automatically activate upon declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting {{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}} or {{ai|Vault|Quinn}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' ends immediately without {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} being cast if she enters or is inside the enemy [[fountain]]. The ability will go on full {{sti|cooldown}}.
** '''Quinn''' will also spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' when entering the enemy fountain.{{bug}}
* Self or allied applied {{tip|immobilize|immobilizations}} such as {{ui|Blast Cone}}, {{ai|Tempered Fate|Bard}}, and {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} also count for ending ''Behind Enemy Lines''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not a [[Channel#Movement Channels|movement channel]], and so will not be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|root}} and {{tip|ground}}.

{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Style'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 6 times.
{{sbc|Style:}} For each stack, '''Samira''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|2.75 to 3.5 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pp|16.5 to 21 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}}|ms}}. At maximum stacks, '''Samira''' can cast ''{{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}}''.
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' basic attacks against targets within {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 200 units of her use her blade, becoming {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}. Blade attacks, ''{{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}'', ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'', and the slash and explosives of ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}}'' deal {{as|{{pp|2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD)}} '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 100 by 5|formula=1% for every 1% missing health|key=%|key1=%|label1=target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}, up to {{as|{{pp|(2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|(3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20|key=%}} AD)}}|magic damage}}.
'''Samira's''' basic attack against an {{tip|immobilized}} target is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and fire {{tt|6 bolts over {{fd|0.5}} seconds|First bolt at the time of cast then once every 0.1 seconds thereafter.}}, each dealing {{as|17% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applying}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}. If the target is a {{tip|monster}} or is {{tip|airborne}}, the attack also {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
The empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Samira's''' basic attack timer, is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once, and cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
If the target is further away from '''Samira's''' {{sti|attack range}}, initiating an attack against the immobilized target while within valid range of them will first cause her to {{tip|dash}} toward them up to her {{sti|attack range}}, then automatically cast the bolts.
Magic
* The ''Style'' stack count is represented by the grades [[File:Samira Rank E.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank D.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank C.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank B.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank A.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank S.png|20px|border|link=]] to the left of '''Samira's''' [[health bar]], visible to the player only, as well as a stack counter under the [[health bar]], visible to all players.
* Abilities blocked by {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}} will still grant '''Samira''' ''Style'' stacks.
* ''Style'' stacks can be generated via {{tip|clones}}.
* Gun and blade attacks do not count as different for the purposes of stacking ''Style''.
* Basic attacks using the blade are still classified as {{tip|ranged}}.
* The blade attack's range condition is unaffected by {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} modifiers (e.g. {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}).
** Its attack range is calculated edge-to-edge, as normal (i.e., {{tip|size}} modifiers on '''Samira''' or her target can still increase the effective distance as basic attack range is added onto unit size).
* The blade attack bonus deals {{tip|default damage}}.
* The blade attack bonus does not apply against {{tip|structures}}.
* The blade attack bonus applies after the primary damage of the attack and is '''not''' an {{tip|on-hit}} effect.
* The empowered attack's bolts deal:
** {{tip|Basic damage}} for the first bolt, as a basic attack would.
** {{tip|Default damage}} for all subsequent bolts.
* Each bolt from the empowered attack rolls for a {{tip|critical strike}} separately.
* The empowered attack will trigger on {{tip|immobilize|immobilizes}} from <u>any</u> source.
** It specifically cannot trigger against enemies affected by {{uis|Blast Cone}} displacement triggered by anyone.{{bug|2}}
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immune}} and {{tip|displacement immune}} targets.
* {{cai|Riposte|Fiora}} can resist the knock up from ''Daredevil Impulse'', but the ability will not trigger its on-{{tip|immobilize|immobilization}} empowerment condition from the attack alone.{{bug|2}}
* '''Samira''' may dash and have her dash to an {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} target canceled an indefinite number of times, so long as the empowered attack has not triggered. When the empowered attack begins, ''Daredevil Impulse's'' cooldown is applied on the target which also prevents her from initiating the dash and the attack again on them for the duration.
* The on-target cooldown will start even if the empowered attack is parried.
* While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Samira''' cannot {{tip|dash}} into range to use the empowered attack. She can only use it if her target is within her {{sti|attack range}} while under this condition.
* The empowered attack will not apply the knock up against {{tip|suspension|suspended}} enemies.
* The empowered attack will only apply the knock up if the target is still {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|airborne}} upon being hit. It will not apply if they are no longer disabled when hit.
* The empowered attack cannot be used against a target with a {{tip|spell shield}}.
* The application of the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} effect can occur on any of the bolts of the empowered attack if it had not already occurred on the first.
** A missile that is parried by {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}} or is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or misses while '''Samira''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}} '''cannot''' apply the knock up in any way.
* The empowered attack's speed is unaffected by {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}} modifiers.
* If '''Samira''' is outside maximum initiation range for the dash when targeting an immobilized target, the player must input a <u>new</u> Attack order on the target upon entering initiation range in order to actually initiate the dash.
** However if '''Samira''' enters the bolts' cast range via her movement while the target is still immobilized without issuing any other commands, the empowered attack will cast without requiring a new order (without the dash).
* The empowered attack removes any forced movement affecting the target once its knock up ends.{{bug|2}}
** {{pending for test}} Does this also happen if it's {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}}.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
If a targetable enemy is in front of '''Samira''' at the time of cast, she will instead slash with her blade in a cone, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
If ''Flair'' is cast during ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'', '''Samira''' deploys explosives in her wake that detonate upon the end of the dash, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
''Flair'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage and will {{tip|applies lifesteal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|0 to 20}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110}}% AD)}}}}
{{ap|6 to 2}}
30
Mana
Physical
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} on the shot and {{tip|area damage}} on the slash and explosives.
* ''Flair's'' shot against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
* ''Flair'' can be cast during ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'' even if ''{{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}'' or ''{{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}}'' are active.
* The slash and explosives roll their {{tip|critical strike}} against each target individually.
* The shot and the slash do not count as different abilities for stacking {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style}}.
* '''Samira's''' next attack after using ''Flair'' will occasionally come out faster.{{bug|2}}
* '''Samira''' can use {{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}} during ''Flair's'' cast time.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** ''Flair'' will fire or slash from wherever '''Samira''' is at the end of the cast time.
*** '''Samira''' will always slash in her facing direction, and she will turn to face the target direction only once at the start of the cast time.
* Only the shot will be destroyed by {{tip|projectile|projectile-intercepting}} effects.
* The explosive placement is illustrated in {{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}} regardless of whether ''Flair'' is available.
** The VFX always covers the the full dash's distance even if {{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}} is interrupted mid-dash.
}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' spins her blade over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, destroying all hostile non-{{tip|turret}} {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} within the area for the duration.
'''Samira''' slashes twice during ''Blade Whirl'', each one dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies. The first slash occurs immediately and the second one occurs after the duration.
'''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} during Blade Whirl. Casting {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} will end Blade Whirl early.''
{{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*2 to 80*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{ap|30 to 22}}
60
Mana
Physical
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage from one slash.
* While the ability has a cast time - the cast time has no effect on the ability's usability. All effects begin immediately and '''Samira''' can move throughout.
* Both slashes count as the same ability for stacking {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style}}.
* The effect ending early includes the second slash not being performed, if applicable.
* Entering {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} will also end ''Blade Whirl'' early.
** Other item actives and channeling {{si|Teleport}} or {{si|Recall}} will ''not'' end the effect early.
* '''Samira''' can ignore the lockout for {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and basic attacks if she uses {{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}} and queues up {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and/or a basic attack at the start of it.{{bug}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' unleashes a torrent of shots for {{rutngt|2.25}}, '''reducing''' her {{as|movement speed}} by {{as|30%|ms}} and rapidly shooting at  nearby enemies over {{rutngt|2}} at sporadic times in {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second intervals|on average; total of 5 intervals of 0.231 and 5 of 0.198 seconds}} each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each shot, reduced by 75% against {{tip|minions}}. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
''A nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy is required to cast this ability, and targets do not have to be visible to be shot at. {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style|image= Samira Rank S.png}} stacks are consumed at the end of the effect.''
'''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} during Inferno Trigger, but she can still move. Inferno Trigger will end prematurely if '''Samira''' is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} as well as {{tip|disarm}}. Inferno Trigger cannot be cast while '''Samira''' is {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}.''
{{st|Physical Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 30% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*10 to 60*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*10}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20*0.25 to 60*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25}}% AD)}}|Total Minion Damage|{{ap|20*0.25*10 to 60*0.25*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25*10}}% AD)}}}}
6 Style
Physical
* '''Samira's''' facing direction remains as it had been or, if she is moving, towards that direction during ''Inferno Trigger''.
* The {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} reduction stacks additively with other {{as|movement speed}} bonuses.
** It is a negative bonus, not a {{tip|slow}}, and is thus not reduced by {{tip|slow resist}}.
* ''Inferno Trigger's'' area of effect is fixed around '''Samira'''.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage of one shot.
* ''Inferno Trigger'' will not end if there are no enemies that remain in range.
* The bottom of the [[Summoner|player's]] screen will have a fiery visual effect while '''Samira''' is at ''S'' rank and ''Inferno Trigger'' has at least one rank.
* Since {{ais|R|Samira}} cooldown is static, {{ri|Ultimate Hunter}} will be swapped with {{ri|Treasure Hunter}} for '''Samira''' at the start of the game.

{{sbc|Innate - Weakened Soul}}: '''Senna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|abilities}} mark enemy champions hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent attacks or ability hits against marked targets will consume the mark to grant '''Senna''' a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Mist}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1 to 10 for 10|formula=1% * level, capped at level 10|key=%}} of the target's '''current''' health}}, rendering the target immune to being marked again for a few seconds. This damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
{{sbc|Innate:}} Enemies that die near '''Senna''' may spawn a ''Mist Wraith'' from their corpse. A ''Mist Wraith'' lasts 8 seconds and '''Senna''' can basic attack or hit it with ''{{ai|Piercing Darkness|Senna}}'' or ''{{ai|Dawning Shadow|Senna}}'' to kill it instantly, granting her {{g|{{#var:gold}}}} and a stack of {{as|Mist}}.
* Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} will spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Epic {{tip|monsters}} will spawn 2 ''Mist Wraiths''.
* {{tip|Minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' kills have a 5% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Large {{tip|minions}} that '''Senna''' does not kill will always spawn a ''Mist Wraith'', while lesser {{tip|minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' does not kill have a 32% chance to spawn one.
* Lesser minions executed by an allied champion's {{nie|Support Quest}} item have a {{fd|8.4}}% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
{{sbc|Mist}}: For each stack of {{as|Mist}}, '''Senna''' gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|{{fd|{{#var:i_ad}}}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}. For every {{#var:stack}} stacks, she also gains {{sti|attack range|20 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{sti|critical strike chance|{{as|{{#var:cs}}% critical strike chance}}}}. Additionally, every {{tt|{{as|1% critical strike chance}}|Counts critical strike chance from items and Mist stacks}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{fd|{{#var:ls}}}}% {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
{{sbc|Innate - Relic Cannon}}: '''Senna's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|20% AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and grant her {{as|{{pp|key=%|10 to 20 for 3|1;6;9}} of the target's movement speed|ms}} as {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
* If a target's mark has a remaining duration less than {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and '''Senna''' starts her basic attack windup on the target during this time, the mark's duration will be modified to {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Subsequent windups on the marked target will refresh this modified duration if the previous attack windup did not complete.
* Despite '''Senna''' dealing 1 damage to ''Mist Wraiths'', attacking them will calculate the {{as|attack's damage|AD}} (including {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers) and any [[on-hit]] effects for the purposes of {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|drain}} effects.
* ''Relic Cannon'' is only applied if the attack deals more than 0 damage.
** Hence, it is not applied if the target is {{tip|invulnerable}} or '''Senna's''' basic attack's {{sti|{{as|attack damage}}}} is reduced to 0 or below.
** The bonus damage is also not applied against {{tip|structures}} (regardless of their vulnerability).
* Dealing 0 damage is valid for marking and collecting {{as|Mist}} from champions, but dealing no damage at all is not.
** Hence, '''Senna''' can mark and collect from {{tip|invulnerable}} enemies.
** {{tip|Dodge}} prevents marking and collecting a {{as|Mist}} via '''Senna's''' basic attacks and {{ai|Q|Senna}}.
** {{Pending for test}}: {{as|Mist}} interaction with {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}}.
* {{ci|Nunu|Nunu & Willump}} spawn a wraith each.
* Enemies will not see newly spawned wraiths while '''Senna''' is not visible.
* A wraith can be hit by {{cai|Cosmic Binding|Bard}} and it will interact with it the same way minions or monsters interact with Cosmic Binding but it will not take damage.
* ''Mist Wraith'' has a spawn animation, but is targetable immediately.
* ''Mist Wraith'' grants a small amount of {{tip|sight}} around itself.
* {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} secondary bolts will ignore ''Mist Wraiths''.
* Attacking a ''Mist Wraith'' will not consume {{nie|Energized}}.
* {{tt|Excluding|Due to lack of available metric}} the range increase and the bonus shielding on {{ai|Dawning Shadow|Senna}}, one stack of {{as|Mist}} is worth {{g|{{#expr:{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:ad}}+{{#var:crit}}*{{#var:cs}}/{{#var:stack}}}}}} ({{g|+{{#var:gold}}}} from ''Mist Wraith'' pickup ({{g|{{#expr:{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:ad}}+{{#var:crit}}*{{#var:cs}}/{{#var:stack}}+{{#var:gold}}}}}} total)), {{g|{{#expr:{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:ad}}+{{#var:lifesteal}}*{{#var:ls}}*{{#var:cs}}/{{#var:stack}}}}}} if the critical chance is converted to life steal.
** {{sti|{{as|{{fd|{{#var:i_ad}} AD}}}}}} is worth {{g|{{#expr:{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:ad}}}}}}.
** {{as|{{sti|critical chance|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:cs}}/{{#var:stack}}}}}}%}} critical strike chance}} is worth {{g|{{#expr:{{#var:crit}}*{{#var:cs}}/{{#var:stack}}}}}}.
*** {{as|{{sti|life steal|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:ls}}*{{#var:cs}}/{{#var:stack}}}}%}}}} life steal}} is worth {{g|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:lifesteal}}*{{#var:ls}}*{{#var:cs}}/{{#var:stack}}}}}}}}.
* The bonus on-hit damage applies an additional stack of {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}}.
* {{sti|Critical strike chance}} gained from {{iis|Yun Tal Wildarrows}} {{nie|Practice Makes Lethal}}, {{tt|Augments and {{ii|Stat Bonus|Stat bonuses}}|Both in Arena and ARAM: Mayhem}} do '''not''' interact with the life steal conversion.{{bug}}
* The buff will be granted even when hitting units that have zero movement speed (from which '''Senna''' cannot gain any movement speed).
** Attacking [[structures]] is special-cased to not grant it at all, however.
* [[Ping|Pinging]] ''Absolution'' in the HUD will send a chat message to the team that displays its stack count and her total {{sti|attack range}} accumulated.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a beam in the direction of the target unit. The beam consists of a wider ray of light, and a narrower ray of shadow at the center.

The shadow ray deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 15% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 7% per 100 AP)}} for a duration. The damage dealt to enemy champions {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness. The light ray {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Senna''' and allied {{tip|champions}} hit. ''Piercing Darkness'' is {{tt|considered|Piercing Darkness doesn't actually apply basic damage}} to trigger a single {{tip|basic attack}} against {{tip|turrets}}, {{tip|wards}}, [[jungle plants]], {{ai|Absolution 3|Senna|Mist Wraiths}} and [[Champion_summoned_units#Targetable|any other attack-interactive units]] hit. It also applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|turrets}} hit, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects against {{tt|one champion hit|see notes}}. ''Piercing Darkness' '' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second {{tip|on-attack}}. {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}}} {{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}} {{st|Healing|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}} 15 {{ap|70 to 110}} Mana Physical * Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the same champion it applies {{tip|on-attack}} effects to and {{tip|area damage}} to all other targets. * The ability's cast time respects the attack speed [[Attack speed|floor and cap]]. ** {{ri|Hail of Blades}} will spend a stack on hitting a champion with ''Piercing Darkness'' but only if {{ri|Hail of Blades}} was activated first by an auto-attack. * '''Senna''' can generally target anything that is not either explicitly {{tip|untargetable}} or herself. ** Valid targets include anything that can be targeted by a basic attack from someone. * ''Piercing Darkness'' respects all {{tip|turret}}-specific rules when striking them. * {{tip|On-hit}} effects are applied in order of struck units' spawn IDs. This matters for effects that are consumed on-hit (e.g. {{tip|Spellblade}}), which are applied to the target with the lowest {{tt|Spawn ID|among enemy champions, this would also be the enemy first pick in Blind Pick mode}}. ** "Spawn ID" is an unofficial abbreviation to describe the spawn order for all units at the start of a game, below are some examples. ** If '''Senna''' targets an enemy champion but hits at least one more enemy champion simultaneously, {{ris|Press the Attack}} first stack will be applied to that target. If no champion was targeted, it will default to the champion with the lowest Spawn ID out of the ones struck by the ability. Whether the effect stacks up on a champion or not when multiple enemy champions are stuck also depends on Spawn ID. ** If ''Piercing Darkness'' struck an enemy champion and turret simultaneously, with {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}} fully charged, the passive effect will most likely trigger on the turret since towers are often spawned before champions. * Similarly, {{tip|on-attack}} effects are applied in order of struck champions' spawn IDs. However, there are some specific on-attack effects that will apply to both the target of ''Piercing Darkness'' and the target with the lowest {{tt|Spawn ID|among enemy champions, this would also be the enemy first pick in Blind Pick mode}} if the two unit is not identical.{{bug|2}} {{tt|Confirmed cases|All under the condition that the targeted enemy champion does NOT have the lowest Spawn ID among all struck enemy champions}}: ** {{nie|Energized}} effects are stacked twice the amount. ** {{Pending for test}} * {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent on-hit effects from being applied. * {{Pending for test}} ''Piercing Darkness'' interaction with {{tip|dodge|dodging}}, {{tip|block|blocking}}, and {{tip|blind|blinding}} effects.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' shrouds herself in an {{tip|aura}} of Black Mist and gains {{tip|camouflage}} for a duration. If '''Senna''' {{tip|breaks stealth|breaks the camouflage}}, she regains it after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth.
Allied champions who enter the mist gain ''Wraith Form'' for a duration equal to the aura's remaining duration.
{{sbc|Wraith Form:}} Gain {{tip|camouflage}}. Enemies are granted {{tip|obscured vision}} of camouflaged ''Wraiths'' moving outside the mist within their line of {{tip|sight}}. ''Wraith Form'' can be regained if lost by breaking the camouflage after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth. ''Wraith Form'' ends immediately upon '''Senna's''' {{tip|death}}.
'''Senna''' and allies camouflaged by ''Curse of the Black Mist'' also gain {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
'''''Senna''' can move during Curse of the Black Mist's cast time.''
{{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|6 to 8}} seconds}}
{{ap|26 to 20}}
70
Mana
* Allies affected by the ''Curse of the Blast Mist'' aura receive a buff called ''Cloak of Mist''.
* Obscured units appear as ''Wraiths'', hence the name. The wraith model does not distinguish which champion is obscured.
** On the [[Map (League of Legends)|mini-map]], obscured champions will be displayed as wraith icons instead of champion icons to the enemy team.
* In-game, the 'Cloak of Mist' buff grants camouflage and the 'Wraith Form' buff obscures the unit and grants movement speed. However, 'Cloak of Mist' has the unspecified effect of negating the obscuring effects of 'Wraith Form' (i.e. the unit is not a wraith while inside the mist); the unit has the bonus movement speed even when they are not a wraith (e.g. inside the mist or an enemy is nearby); and 'Wraith Form' also grants the functionality of camouflage (i.e. the unit is treated as a camouflaged unit with regards to {{tip|True Sight}}, {{ii|Control Ward|Control Wards}}, and enemy {{tip|champions}}).
** Given this overly complex interaction between the two buffs granted as well as the overlapping effects, it is easier to describe the effects as a single buff that is modified in specific circumstances rather than trying to establish a new game mechanic.
** '''Senna''' likewise has her aura buff and the 'Wraith Form' buff, but her 'Wraith Form' does not share gameplay functionality with other allies benefiting from Wraith Form. For '''Senna''', the appearance of being a wraith is a form-swap while camouflaged (similar to {{cai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}}). '''Senna''' will remain in her wraith form when she is detected so long as the camouflage effect isn't broken, and her wraith's appearance is very distinct from other wraiths.
* Allied champions who enter the mist and have {{tip|stealth}} of their own will still gain the ''Wraith Form'' buff but they will not grant {{tip|obscured vision}} of themselves to the enemy while out of the mist nor will they appear as a ''Wraith''.
** Allies who have their own {{tip|camouflage}} and also have ''Wraith Form'' will be revealed to enemies from their stealth's detection range, not ''Wraith Form's''.
* If '''Senna''' gains {{tip|invisibility}} while {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} by ''Curse of the Black Mist'', the visual effects of her aura will be hidden while she is invisible.
* ''Curse of the Black Mist'' will not activate if '''Senna''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during the cast time.
* ''Wraith Form'' will not be granted to allies that are in a {{tip|zombie state}} or are {{tip|channel|channeling}}. It will be granted to allies even if they are {{tip|untargetable}}.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
** The stealth regain timer is refreshed from basic attacks at the start of their attack windup.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' spits a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 75|critScaling=true}}; applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects; applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness; and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' kills at least one target, '''Smolder''' restores {{sti|{{as|15 mana}}}}.
''Super Scorcher Breath'' becomes empowered with new effects based on the number of ''{{as|{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks|buzzword3}}'':
{{sbc|Tier 1 - 25 stacks:}} The fireball explodes upon collision to deal the same {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. The explosion benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
{{sbc|Tier 2 - 125 stacks:}} The fireball sends forth 2 {{as|(+ {{fd|0.8}} per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts of fire in an arc upon collision that explode at maximum range, dealing {{ap|{{#var:t2_mod}}*100}}% of the same damage to enemies hit. The bolts benefit from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' attack range}} for 6 seconds, during which his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} are replaced by ''bolts'' that travel slightly further than his attack range in a straight line, dealing damage to {{tt|every enemy unit|non-champions and champions, wards and plants, turrets and structures}} hit.
The ''bolts'' deal {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|110-10*x|0 to 4 for 5|formula=100% - 10% per enemy hit. ''This is capped at 60% damage.''|changedisplay=true}} of the triggering {{as|attack's damage|AD}}, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Twitch|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|30 to 60}}}}
90
100
Mana
Physical
* The extra distance that the ''bolts'' travel scales with '''bonus''' attack range.
* ''Spray and Pray'' allows '''Twitch''' to outrange {{tip|turret|turrets}} by 50 units, allowing him to hit them without them returning fire.
* '''Twitch''' targets his line attack at his target's location at the ''start'' of his attack windup.
** The ''bolts'' reach targets at a delay, composed of '''Twitch's''' windup time and distance the ''bolt'' has to travel at finite speed. Even the primary target can dodge the attack if they are moving quickly enough.
* {{tip|On-attack}} effects such as {{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}} and {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} will be triggered as usual from the completion of '''Twitch's''' basic attack windup. They will obey their standard target-acquisition rules in spite of ''Spray and Pray's'' special basic attack behavior.
* The ''bolt'' projectiles will naturally pass through terrain and enemy structures (the latter will be damaged by ''bolts'' even if they are not directly targeted).
* If '''Twitch''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}} before winding up the attack, the hits will ''miss'' against '''all''' targets.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} interacts with ''Spray and Pray's'' {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} but not with the modified missile effect (the secondary bolts will not have pass-through effects).
* Whenever the ''bolts'' penetrate a target, a small elongated cloud appears at the location, which's VFX and SFX '''can''' be seen and heard inside the Fog of War.
* The ''bolts<nowiki>'</nowiki>'' travel distance scales with the full value of '''Twitch's''' {{sti|range|attack range}} increases such as {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}, but not with size increases (which only increase his effective attack range, thereby the target range).
* (Outdated as of [[V10.13]], now can hit everything with edge range, except for turrets) The {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} center of a unit must be within the maximum travel distance of the ''bolt'' missile, and in front of the spawn location ('''Twitch's''' {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} center) for the ''bolt'' to be able to hit them.
** Other than this condition, the ''bolt'' missile has to only touch (pass within its half width of 60 units) the {{tip|er|icononly = true}} edge of the unit's radius.
** This is standard behaviour for ''linear skillshots''.

{{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Varus''' kills an enemy, he gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{pp|10 to 20|1;7;13|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}} equal to {{as|11% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}} for {{pp|5 to 11 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent unit kills.
'''Varus''' also gains ''Living Vengeance's'' bonuses upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}, which empowers it for the same duration to grant him {{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}} as well as {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} and {{as|ability power}} equal to {{as|33% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}}, and an increased attack speed cap of {{fd|3.33}}. ''Living Vengeance's'' empowerment may only be refreshed by subsequent champion takedowns.
* '''Varus''' cannot gain the standard bonuses while ''Living Vengeance'' is empowered. If the buff was active at the time of the empowerment (from scoring a champion takedown), the duration is refreshed while overriding the standard bonuses with the empowered ones.
** If '''Varus''' kills an enemy unit (non-champion) during the empowerment, he is special cased to gain the buff again after the empowerment expires with the standard bonuses. The re-granted buff lasts for {{pp|5 to 11 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds minus the remaining duration of the empowered version at the time of the last non-champion unit he killed.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Varus''' unleashes a tendril of corruption in the target direction that infects the first enemy champion hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. Over the first {{tt|{{fd|1.75}} seconds|Estimated, see notes for specific stack application timings}} of the root, they are also inflicted with maximum stacks of ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}''.
Upon impact, the tendril roots into the ground from where the target was hit, seeking out nearby enemy {{tip|champions}} that are in the immediate area. If a target does not leave the area within 2 seconds, they subsequently become infected as well, taking the same damage and effects. A new tendril is then spread out from the infected target that is closest to a nearby uninfected enemy champion. The infection can spread repeatedly until there are no new targets.
''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be caught by the tendril.''
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{ap|100 to 60}}
100
mana
Magic
* The first {{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}} stack is applied after ~{{fd|0.65}} seconds into the {{tip|root}} duration, while the remaining ones are applied in {{fd|0.55}}-second intervals thereafter.
** Second and third stacks are applied after ~{{fd|1.2}} seconds and ~{{fd|1.75}} seconds into the root duration, respectively.
** If the root's duration is reduced by the target's {{tip|tenacity}}, the stacks are applied depending upon if their time application interval is met.
*** For example, if the root lasts for 1 second, only the first stack is applied since the second and third stacks did not meet their time intervals.
*** If the root lasts for less than the first stack application time (<{{fd|0.65}} seconds), the first stack will instead be applied at the end of the root duration.
** If the target {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} the root immediately after it is applied, no stacks will be applied.
*** In cases where the cleanse is activated later into the root duration, stack application is dependent upon their time application interval being met. If removal occurs before an interval after one having been passed, remaining stacks are not applied.
* If the {{tip|root}} is not applied, such as by the target negating its application with {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} or a {{tip|spell shield}}, the target will not be inflicted with {{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}} stacks and the tendril will not root into the ground at their location (thus preventing it from seeking). This applies to both the primary target and secondary targets that were caught by the tendril.
* The tendril seeks and registers valid targets every {{rutngt|0.25}}.
* Enemy champions can be targeted again by the corruption's tether if they were not infected the previous time, even if they were targeted and exited its range.
* The tendril cannot seek enemy champions that are {{tip|untargetable}}, and will also stop seeking a target if it becomes untargetable (fails to apply its effects even if they remain in the area).
* '''Varus''' will turn to face the target direction at the start of the cast.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Chain of Corruption'' can generate ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}'' stacks for '''Varus''' to detonate with any ability, even if ''Blighted Quiver'' has not been learned. The '''base''' detonation damage per ''Blight'' stack scales with ''Blighted Quiver's'' rank, which has a value at rank 0 of {{as|{{fd|2.5}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health}} per stack detonated.
}}

{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Xayah's''' {{tip|ability}} casts generate 3 {{tip|stacks}} of ''Clean Cuts'', lasting for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts, and stacking up to 5 times. '''Xayah's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to each consume a stack {{tip|on-attack}} to instead shoot a {{as|Feather|buzzword}} that deals the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} to the primary target and {{as|{{pp|key=%|35 to 55 for 3|1 to 13}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to other enemies hit. The secondary target damage can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Xayah|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage if the triggering attack does.
{{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Xayah''' or {{ci|Rakan}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.
physical
* Deals {{tip|basic damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets.
* {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} will stop upon being intercepted by {{tip|projectile|projectile-blocking}} effects.
** {{Pending for test}}: {{tip|homing projectile destruction|Missile popping}} before and after striking the primary target.
* After striking their target, the attack will proceed in a line in the same direction it was already flying.
** If the target is more than 1000 units from '''Xayah''' when the empowered attack hits them, the attack will not keep flying in a line and drop the {{as|Feather|buzzword}} at their location immediately.
** Unlike similar effects, the homing and line trajectories use the same missile.
* All her {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} on the ground will be destroyed when '''Xayah''' {{tip|death|dies}}, and while she is dead, missiles that are still in flight will not spawn new ones, either.
* ''Clean Cut's'' feathers will spawn even if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
* ''Clean Cut's'' hit can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} by or {{tip|blind|missed}} against the primary target.
** This will not prevent the missile from continuing on its path nor from dealing damage to secondary targets. The damage cannot be dodged as or missed against a secondary target.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
** The duration will be refreshed when starting the attack windup against them.
* The number of ''Clean Cuts'' stacks available is represented by a [[File:Xayah Passive Feather.png|20px|link=]] feather counter in her ammo bar, visible to the player only.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' barrages two {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} in the target direction that each deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
Targets hit after the first take 50% reduced damage.
{{st|Physical Damage Per Hit|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*2 to 105*2}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Reduced Damage per Hit|{{ap|45/2 to 105/2}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Reduced Damage|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{ap|10 to 8}}
35
Mana
Physical
* Daggers shoot from '''Xayah's''' left and right side.
* Because of the usual tick intervals of the server, ''Double Daggers' ''minimum cast time is typically reached at {{as|{{fd|168.58}}% '''bonus''' attack speed}} already, for a cast time of {{fd|0.132}} seconds (from the default {{rutngt|0.25}}), or the duration of 4 game ticks.
** If the first 3 game ticks happen to be slightly longer than normal, the minimum cast time of {{fd|0.1}} seconds can actually be reached in very rare cases because of that.
* '''Xayah''' is unable to declare basic attacks for a set duration during the cast time of ''Double Daggers''. The lock out duration is reduced by {{ft|{{fd|0.007}} seconds per every {{as|1% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|1 second per every {{as|140% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
* The {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} will stop upon being intercepted by {{tip|projectile|projectile-blocking}} effects.
* As the feathers are forming, they will deal damage in a small area around '''Xayah's''' before firing.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single instance of damage.
{{Effect at cast time end}}

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' recalls all planted {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} to shoot back to her, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 50|critScaling=true}}. ''Bladecaller'' deals 50% damage to {{tip|minions}}.
An enemy takes {{pp|type=previous feathers hit|key=%|100 to 10 by 5|x-1|formula=100%-(5% per previous feather hit). ''This is capped at 10% damage.''}} damage from a {{as|Feather|buzzword}}.
A target hit by at least three {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} is {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
''A planted {{as|Feather|buzzword}} is required to cast this ability. Enemies can be hit by an individual {{as|Feather|buzzword}} only once per pass.''
{{st|Physical Damage Per Feather|{{ap|50 to 110}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion Damage Per Feather|{{ap|50/2 to 110/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40/2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{ap|12 to 8}}
20
Mana
Physical
* {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} that are 'in flight' will be called to '''Xayah''' too, but only once they've landed normally first.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single instance of damage.
* This ability cannot be ranked at [[Experience (champion)|Level]] 1.
* The damage dealt by ''Bladecaller'' follows a diminishing returns formula not mentioned in the ability's description, successively reducing extra damage from feathers beyond the first.
** This formula is:
*** For feathers <=19: Damage of one feather{{times}}(n{{minus}}{{fd|0.05}}{{times}}(n{{minus}}1){{divided by}}2{{times}}n) where n stands for the number of feathers hit.
*** For feathers >=20: Damage of one feather{{times}}(19{{minus}}{{fd|0.05}}{{times}}(19{{minus}}1){{divided by}}2{{times}}19{{plus}}0.1{{times}}(n{{minus}}19)) where n stands for the number of feathers hit.
** For example, at rank 1 ''Bladecaller'' deals {{pp|type=feathers hit|50*(x-0.05*(x-1)/2*x) for 19}}.
* ''Bladecaller'' cannot be cast without a {{as|Feather|buzzword}} on the ground.

magic

{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. While this ability is inactive, her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Unleash'' for 6 seconds, increased to 2 stacks against {{tip|champions}}. The stacks refresh on subsequent attacks, stack up to 8 times, and expire one by one every {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the duration. {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' unleashes for 5 seconds: gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, dealing {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, and augmenting her basic attacks to have increased missile speed, a 40% lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} time, and an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}. Her basic attacks are also empowered to spread to each enemy near the target, dealing {{as|30% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.
Each spread attack {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 30% effectiveness, and will {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Yunara|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage if the triggering attack does. Spread attacks deal 250% damage against {{tip|minions}} {{as|below 30% '''maximum''' health}}. ''Cultivation of Spirit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Yunara's''' basic attack timer. Targets do not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the spread attacks.'' {{st|Passive Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:pb1}} to {{#var:pb5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:pap}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}} {{st|Active Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:ab1}} to {{#var:ab5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:aap}}% AP)}}|Combined Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:pb1}}+{{#var:ab1}} to {{#var:pb5}}+{{#var:ab5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:aap}}+{{#var:pap}}}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Active Increased Minion Damage|{{ap|{{#var:ab1}}*2.5 to {{#var:ab5}}*2.5}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:20*2.5}}% AP)}}|Combined Increased Minion Damage|{{ap|({{#var:pb1}}+{{#var:ab1}})*2.5 to ({{#var:pb5}}+{{#var:ab5}})*2.5}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:({{#var:aap}}+{{#var:pap}})*2.5}}% AP)}}}} 30 Mana + 8 Unleash Stacks Physical Magic * ''Cultivation of Spirit's'' damage classifications: ** {{tip|Proc damage}} for the passive and active on-hit damage. ** {{tip|Basic damage}} for the spread attack damage. * Spread attacks will still deal damage even if '''Yunara''' misses her basic attack due to {{tip|blind}}. * {{Pending for test}} Spread attack interaction with parrying effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}) * There is no limit to the number of enemies the empowered attacks can spread to. * '''Yunara's''' secondary resource bar gives various context for ''Cultivation of Spirit''. It is visible to the player only. ** While ''Cultivation of Spirit'' is not active, the bar shows her current ''Unleash'' stacks. It is colored white while below maximum stacks and yellow while at maximum stacks. ** After ''Cultivation of Spirit'' is cast, the bar counts down the buff's duration. *** This is also true during {{ai|Transcend One's Self|Yunara}}, which means that the bar effectively also counts down the duration of her ''Transcendent State''. * If '''Yunara''' begins an {{tip|attack windup}} toward the end of the active effects' duration and its launch would take place after it, the effects' duration is extended equal to the attack's windup time, once at most. ** Since the buff ends right after launching ''Cultivation of Spirit's'' attack and its effects have already been determined, this allows it to both spread to nearby enemies and generate a stack of ''Unleash''. * Each bolt from {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} may trigger its own spread attack (despite the spread attacks not being an on-hit effect).

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' launches a spinning prayer bead in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot see through terrain nor brush}} as it travels. The bead slows down significantly while colliding with an enemy, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration; upon reaching maximum range, it will expand and linger in place for 1 second regardless of enemies hit.

The initial hit against each enemy before the bead's expansion deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. While lingering, the bead deals {{#expr:{{#var:lm}}*100/4}}% of the impact damage as {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ''Arc of Judgment'' deals {{pp|50 to 100 for 3|1;9;13|key=%}} damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} them if they would be killed by 6 more damage instances from the linger effect. {{st|Initial Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}} to {{#var:b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:adr}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#var:apr}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Linger Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|({{#var:b1}}*{{#var:lm}})/4 to ({{#var:b5}}*{{#var:lm}})/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|({{#var:adr}}*{{#var:lm}})/4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|({{#var:apr}}*{{#var:lm}})/4}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Total Expanded Damage|{{ap|(({{#var:b1}}*{{#var:lm}})/4)*4 to (({{#var:b5}}*{{#var:lm}})/4)*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(({{#var:adr}}*{{#var:lm}})/4)*4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(({{#var:apr}}*{{#var:lm}})/4)*4}}% AP)}}}} 10 60 mana magic * Applies {{tip|area damage}} for the initial hit and {{tip|persistent area damage}} for the lingering effect. * {{tip|Spell shield}} can block either the initial hit or one damage tick of the lingering effect.{{Effect at cast time end}} * ''Arc of Judgment'' can hit an enemy more than once with the initial damage as well with the lingering effect (both while not expanded and while expanded). ** The bead can hit an enemy multiple times if they collide with it again while it is in flight.

{{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'' base damage and ''{{ais|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'' dash speed scale with ''Transcend One's Self's'' rank.
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' enters ''Transcendent State'' for 15 seconds, during which each of her basic abilities is empowered:
{{lc|{{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}}}} Automatically becomes active at no cost, with the duration increased to ''Transcendent State's''.
{{lc|{{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}} reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.
{{lc|{{ai|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|cooldown}} reset upon both entering and exiting the state.
{{st|[[File: Yunara Arc of Ruin.png|20px|border|link=]] Arc of Ruin Base Damage|{{ap|160 to 480}}}}
{{st|[[File: Yunara Untouchable Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] Untouchable Shadow Dash Speed|{{ap|1350 to 1650}}}}
{{ap|100 to 80}}
100
Mana
* An ongoing ''{{ais|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' effect is not lost when quickly replaced by ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}''.
* {{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}} is cast alongside ''Transcend One's Self''. If the former was not already active, this will also grant its {{tip|basic attack reset|attack reset}}.
** The attack reset does '''not''' originate from ''Transcend One's Self'' nor is ''Transcend One's Self'' tagged as granting one itself (e.g. for the purposes of {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
* ''Transcend One's Self'' cannot be cast again while active.

candidates.sourceText:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zeri''' generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', up to a maximum of 100 charge. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} consume charge to deal '''modified''' damage.
'''Zeri''' gains maximum charge when the game starts and upon [[respawn]]ing. {{tip|Basic Attack|{{sbc|Basic Attack:}}}} '''Zeri''' zaps the target, dealing {{as|{{pp|10+(15/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, applying {{tip|spell effects}} as {{tip|spell damage}}, triggering on-cast effects and {{ccs|executing|magic}} the target if they are below {{pp|70 + (160-70)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=hp}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. This cannot {{tip|critically strike}} and does not apply nor trigger {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects. At full charge, '''Zeri's''' next attack is empowered to consume all charge to deal {{as|{{pp|75 + (160-75)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|1 + (11-1)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}. {{dv|{{tt|10|Regular zaps}}|{{tt|100|Full charge zap}}}} charge magic * Charged attacks only deal the '''base''' damage to {{tip|structures}}. * Uncharged attacks do not execute enemies that are {{tip|shield|shielded}} or {{tip|invulnerable}} while below the health threshold. * {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a fully charged attack. Uncharged attacks are not blocked. * The attack's range '''is''' affected by attack range modifiers ({{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}) (tested on patch 26.12). * Uncharged and charged attacks trigger {{iis|Tear of the Goddess}} {{nie|Mana Charge}}. * Attacking a turret does not consume [[Crystalline Overgrowth]]. * The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against {{tip|wards}} or [[jungle plants]]. * If [[Minion#Last_Hit_Indicator|Last Hit Indicator]] enabled, it will indicate ''Living Battery's'' {{tip|execute}} threshold instead of its usual function.

candidates.sourceText:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' fires a burst of {{#var:rounds}} rounds in the target direction over the cast time, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
''Burst Fire's'' projectile is treated as a {{tip|basic attack}}: it hits any enemy unit a typical basic attack can; deals {{tip|basic damage}}; can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Zeri|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage; and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit. ''Burst Fire's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and cast time are reduced with {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}}, with the maximum of {{as|{{fd|1.5}}|attack speed}} attacks per second. 60% of {{as|attack speed}} in excess of the cap is converted into {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
'''''Zeri''' can cast Burst Fire while {{tip|silence|silenced}}.''
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}} to {{#var:b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}} to {{#var:ad5}}}}% AD)}}|Total Critical Strike Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:crit}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:crit}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:crit}} to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:crit}}}}% AD)}}|Total Infinity Edge Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}}) to {{#var:b5}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}}) to {{#var:ad5}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}/{{#var:rounds}} to {{#var:b5}}/{{#var:rounds}}|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}/{{#var:rounds}} to {{#var:ad5}}/{{#var:rounds}}|round=2}}% AD)}}|Critical Strike per Hit|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:crit}}/{{#var:rounds}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:crit}}/{{#var:rounds}}|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:crit}}/{{#var:rounds}} to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:crit}}/{{#var:rounds}}|round=2}}% AD)}}|Infinity Edge Damage per Hit|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/{{#var:rounds}} to {{#var:b5}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/{{#var:rounds}}|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/{{#var:rounds}} to {{#var:ad5}}*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/{{#var:rounds}}|round=2}}% AD)}}}}
None
Physical
* ''Burst Fire'' is automatically learned with her first skill point upon spawning.
* ''Burst Fire'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} and does not trigger {{tip|spell effects}}. It is additionally tagged as [[area of effect]] when damaging targets after the first.
* ''Burst Fire'' is still locked out while '''Zeri''' is affected by any form of other {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
** {{tip|Silence}} is special cased to specifically not disable ''Burst Fire''.
** {{tip|Polymorph}}, despite functioning identically to {{tip|silence}}, will still lock ''Burst Fire'' from being cast.
* Any of ''Burst Fire's'' rounds hitting a champion will draw minion aggro, regardless of whether or not other targets were hit first by ''Burst Fire's'' rounds.
** A lightning chain from a {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri}} empowered ''Burst Fire'' will not draw minion aggro.
* Casting ''Burst Fire'' does not cancel previous attack ({{ai|Living Battery|Zeri}}) and movement orders.
* ''Burst Fire'' does not trigger {{iis|Tear of the Goddess}} {{nie|Mana Charge}}.
* ''Burst Fire's'' cooldown is not reduced by {{iis|Navori Flickerblade}} {{nie|Transcendence}}.
* {{cais|Tantrum|Amumu}}, {{cais|Nimble Fighter|Fizz}}, and {{cais|Eclipse|Leona}} flat damage reduction apply to '''each''' of the 7 instances of damage from ''Burst Fire''.
** {{iis|Warden's Mail}} flat damage reduction and cap only apply to the first instance of damage.
** {{iis|Guardian's Horn}} flat damage reduction only applies to the first instance of damage, but handles it as damage-over-time (reduced to 25% effectiveness).
* ''Burst Fire'' still counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** It does '''not''' count as an ability activation for {{tip|Spellblade}}.
* ''Burst Fire'' can hit '''all''' enemy units that a basic attack would be able to target. This does include [[jungle plants]], [[structure]]s, and [[ward]]s.
** Wards will only be hit once by ''Burst Fire''. [[Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|Stealthed wards and traps]] will not take damage.
*** ''Burst Fire'' will still apply {{tip|on-attack}} effects to stealthed traps and wards.{{bug}}
*** {{ci|Neeko}} will be hit multiple times while {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}} as a ward, but any subsequent rounds will continue to travel through.
** Champion-summoned units behave differently depending on the unit.
*** {{cai|Powder Keg|Gangplank|Powder Keg}} and {{cai|Dark Procession|Yorick}} are hit only once by ''Burst Fire'', and any subsequent rounds not empowered by {{ai|Spark Surge|Zeri}} will stop upon reaching the same object.
*** {{cai|Sentinel|Kalista}} is hit only once by ''Burst Fire'', but any subsequent rounds will continue to travel through the ''Sentinel''.
* If ''Burst Fire'' hits an enemy while '''Zeri''' is not visible to enemies, the area around her (400 units) will be revealed for {{fd|4.5}} seconds.
* ''Burst Fire'' rolls {{tip|critical strike}} for all rounds as well as the additional physical damage dealt when '''Zeri''' is {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri|Overcharged}}.
* ''Burst Fire'' is parried by {{tip|dodge}} and {{tip|block}}.
** {{tip|Blind}} causes ''Burst Fire'' to cast in a random direction. The rounds will still deal damage to enemies hit.
* ''Burst Fire's'' rounds are each fired in the target direction from where '''Zeri''' is at the time.
* '''Only''' attack speed granted by being {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri|Overcharged}} can exceed the cap of {{fd|1.5}}.
** {{ri|Hail of Blades}} does not allow '''Zeri''' to exceed her attack speed cap.
* Item and rune effects that trigger off of attacking (e.g., {{ri|Fleet Footwork}} and {{ii|Kraken Slayer}}) will only trigger if ''Burst Fire'' hits a unit.
* If '''Zeri''' would reach maximum {{tip|Energized}} stacks from a ''Burst Fire'' cast, the remaining rounds will trigger ''Energized's'' effect.
* ''Burst Fire's'' cast-indicator does not show {{sti|range}} increases; modified range VFX are still visible around the champion model.
* ''Burst Fire'' can apply the effect of {{ii|Horizon Focus}} when the enemy hit is within the last 50 units of this ability.{{bug|2}}
* ''Burst Fire'' uses a modified icon when empowered by {{ai|Spark Surge|Zeri}} ([[File:Zeri Burst Fire 2.png|20px|link=]]) and {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri}} ([[File:Zeri Burst Fire 3.png|20px|link=]]) as well as both ([[File:Zeri Burst Fire 4.png|20px|link=]]).
* Destroying a ward that is targetable but not visible to '''Zeri's''' team (e.g. a {{ii|Control Ward}} in [[Fog of War]]) via ''Burst Fire'' uniquely allows her to remove its accompanying [[Ward#Ward_Timers|ward timer]] (if it exists) without seeing the ward being destroyed.
* If '''Zeri''' is affected by an ally {{cai|Tempered Fate|Bard}} during ''Burst Fire's'' cast time, she will be able to cast it during the effect.{{bug}}
}}

candidates.sourceText:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' discharges an electric nova that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one enemy champion, she enters ''Overcharged'' for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack will extend the duration by {{fd|2.5}} seconds, up to its original duration.
{{sbc|Overcharged:}} '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{as|{{sti|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and an increased attack speed cap of {{as|{{ap|1.5+({{ccd|Zeri|as_ratio}}*0.3)}}|as}}. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' is empowered to have a 20% shorter cast time and a decreased spread angle, and instead fires 3 rounds that travel with increased speed. The first round to hit an enemy per {{tip|cast instance}} chains electricity to the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within 650 units of the target, up to 4 subsequent targets, to deal {{as|40% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|40}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
During ''Overcharged'', '''Zeri''' can generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Hypercharged'' from enemy champions that last {{fd|2.5}} seconds. She generates 1 stack for each one she hits with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack, increased to 3 on abilities that {{tip|critically strike}}. Subsequent hits refresh the duration of ''Hypercharged''. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' grants stacks only against the first target hit.
{{sbc|Hypercharged:}} For each stack, '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|{{fd|1.5}}% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
'''''Zeri''' can move during Lightning Crash's cast time.''
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}}}}
{{ap|80 to 70}}
100
Mana
Physical Magic
* ''Lightning Crash'' does not interrupt '''Zeri's''' previous orders.
* '''Zeri''' can stack ''Hypercharged'' up to 100,000 times.
* Applies {{tip|area damage}} for the nova and {{tip|proc damage}} for the chain lightning.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} blocks ''Lightning Crash's'' initial nova but does not prevent '''Zeri''' from becoming ''Overcharged''.
** It does not block ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' electricity chain.
* {{tip|Clone|Clones}} count for granting ''Overcharge''.
* ''Lightning Crash's'' and ''{{ais|Spark Surge|Zeri}}'' empowerments to ''{{ai|Burst Fire 4|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' can combine together.
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' electricity chain will not trigger if the first target hit is a {{tip|ward}} or {{tip|stealthed trap|trap}}, even if it is [[Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed]]. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WzZ3PGwEBik] {{bug}}|affectedEffects=Zeri R|estimatedPatchOrigin=V12.2|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1774305490|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Zeri/Lightning Crash
}}
* ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' electricity chain will not chain across {{tip|structures}}.
* Entering {{tip|resurrection}} causes '''Zeri''' to lose all stacks of ''Hypercharged''.
** ''Overcharged'' is not removed, however.{{bug|2}}
** '''Zeri''' will not be able to gain stacks of ''Hypercharged'' again after reviving while ''Overcharged'' is active.{{bug}}
